"Noble Consort, why do you repeatedly do this? Do you enjoy teasing Tingxue so much?"

"How is this teasing?" Xiangjun suddenly became serious. "The first time I met Tingxue, what I said to Lord Gu still holds true today."

chapters.title: Tingxue's Heart is Too Well Hidden
chapters.content:
Gu Tingxue averted Xiangjun's gaze, turning his face to the side. "Even if Noble Consort doesn't act this way, I will still help you. You really don't need to do this."

Xiangjun stretched out her hand and wrapped it around Gu Tingxue's waist.

Her voice was soft but seductive.

"But Xiangjun wants to know how far Tingxue is willing to go for me... Xiangjun wants to know if Tingxue would dare to do something treasonous with me."

Xiangjun's words made Gu Tingxue's restless heart suddenly turn cold.

Gu Tingxue looked deeply into Xiangjun's eyes.

As expected, she had no genuine feelings for him. It was all just a test and exploitation.

But she was generous, to the point of testing a eunuch like this.

"Why must Noble Consort test me in this way?"

"Tingxue's heart is too well hidden. I cannot see through it."

Gu Tingxue suddenly felt that the woman in front of him was cruel. She was all false sentiments towards him, yet she wanted to use her falsehood to gauge his sincerity.

It was truly cruel.

Gu Tingxue took hold of Xiangjun's hand, which was wrapped around his waist, and gently moved it away. Then he stood up, took a step back, and put distance between himself and Xiangjun.

Xiangjun showed her displeasure. As expected, he still had some loyalty to the Emperor.

Xiangjun had clearly felt Gu Tingxue's different feelings for her, but in the end, he was unwilling to take that last step.

Gu Tingxue was unwilling to explain his reasons. Xiangjun could only guess that it was because he still had a sense of loyalty to the Emperor and was unwilling to touch the Emperor's woman.

Xiangjun instantly felt a sense of frustration and leaned back against the high pile of soft pillows, restraining her gaze as she looked at Gu Tingxue.

"It seems Tingxue always has reservations about me."

Gu Tingxue met Xiangjun's cold gaze and was not angered by her condescending tone.

In fact, he rather liked the occasional dominance Xiangjun displayed. He felt that this side of Xiangjun was more genuine than when she fawned and sought favor.

"Tingxue does not dare. Tingxue only does not want to tarnish Noble Consort's eyes."

Gu Tingxue slightly lowered his head, his attitude unusually respectful.

Xiangjun felt stifled but knew she couldn't rush things. She had to set this aside for now and asked, "Did Tingxue come tonight because there is something you need to discuss with me?"

"Before coming to Chengxiang Palace, Tingxue had just been to Ganlu Palace."

Xiangjun coldly humphed, "Guifei summons you quite often."

Xiangjun looked at Gu Tingxue, her eyes holding a hint of a young girl's pettiness, as if she was jealous.

Gu Tingxue averted his gaze and walked to the side to sit down. Looking at the teacup in front of him, he said, "Rong Guifei wants to know about the Emperor's intimate affairs with you, Noble Consort."

Xiangjun frowned, her expression complex.

What was wrong with Rong Guifei?

Seeing Xiangjun's confusion, Gu Tingxue explained further, "Rong Guifei has not attended to the Emperor since giving birth."

Xiangjun was surprised. "Doesn't the Emperor often visit Rong Guifei?"

"He has, but never once has he summoned Rong Guifei to his bed."

Xiangjun was shocked. Could it be that every time the Emperor visited Rong Guifei, he only slept under the covers with her?

Weren't they truly in love?

Why had things changed after Rong Guifei gave birth?

Xiangjun asked Gu Tingxue many more details, starting from the day Rong Guifei gave birth, and asked thoroughly about everything.

Afterward, Xiangjun pondered for a moment before finally having an epiphany.

That dog Emperor was really something else.

Xiangjun looked at Gu Tingxue and said helplessly, "I suspect that when the Emperor accompanied Guifei in childbirth, he saw the scene of the Fourth Prince's birth... That scene was too terrifying. The Emperor might have developed a shadow towards Guifei because of it."

Gu Tingxue fell silent. He hadn't considered this possibility.

"It is indeed possible."

Xiangjun thought for a moment and then said to Gu Tingxue, "When I give birth in the future, you are not allowed to watch, lest you develop a shadow towards me as well."

Gu Tingxue's heart felt as if it had been grabbed.

What shadow could he have?

It wasn't as if he would...

Gu Tingxue didn't have time to think it through. Xiangjun asked again, "Guifei is asking about how I serve the Emperor. She wouldn't hold a grudge against me, would she?"

Gu Tingxue came back to his senses and glanced at Xiangjun with exasperation. "Wake up. In the entire harem, aside from Li Guiji, there is no one who doesn't dislike you."

Xiangjun pouted, looking quite aggrieved. "Ah? Am I that dislikable? Sigh, all my previous efforts were in vain."

"You don't need to keep up the act now. It's not like when you first entered the palace."

Xiangjun considered Gu Tingxue's words and felt a surge of pride.

"That's true. I didn't endure so much hardship just to swallow my pride. Now I am Deyi, with a prince under my name, and I have Tingxue's assistance. What do I have to fear?"

Gu Tingxue deliberately said, "Noble Consort has today's status because of the Emperor's favor."

Xiangjun coldly humphed, "The Emperor's favor is the least reliable. I would rather have Tingxue's genuine heart."

Seeing the conversation return to himself, Gu Tingxue took his leave.

Watching Gu Tingxue leave, Xiangjun huffed in annoyance.

That dog of a servant was even harder to seduce than the Emperor.

...

Weiyang Palace.

The Empress looked at the recent records from the Shang Qin Bureau and smiled.

Madame Fang softly said, "I heard that Guifei is very displeased with Lian Deyi."

The Empress coldly laughed, "I said long ago that Guifei doesn't have the mind to wield such a sharp knife. Now, Lian Deyi has both favor and a son, her foundation is stable. As long as she doesn't make any major mistakes, no one can easily touch her. Why should she still fawn over Guifei?"

"Wasn't Lian Deyi sincere in choosing Guifei initially?"

"She is indeed clever and knows how to pick the soft persimmon. If she had thrown her lot in with me back then, although she would have gained more benefits, she would also have had to serve my purposes. But Guifei is different. She doesn't even realize when she's being used. Even now, when she's displeased, she doesn't know how to teach her a lesson. I even find Guifei's actions uninteresting."

Madame Fang asked, "Has the Emperor's favor for Guifei truly lessened?"

The Empress's gaze darkened. "Never underestimate Guifei. Although she herself is incompetent, she is surrounded by vicious dogs that bite hard when they do. We'll see how Lian Deyi handles this."

...

After Song Feijing's injuries healed, he returned to the court. The first matter he took charge of was this year's imperial examinations.

Not long after, Xiangjun received a letter from home.

In the two years since she had entered the palace, this was the first time her good father had written to her.

The Xu family was in Jiangnan. To deliver a letter into the harem would require a considerable amount of money and effort, so it was unlikely to be a trivial matter.

Xiangjun opened the letter and, as she had suspected, it was indeed important.

The letter stated that her brother, Xu Huanwen, had come first in the provincial examinations this year but was accused of cheating and thrown into prison. He hoped that Xiangjun could find a way to save him.

Xiangjun closed the letter.

As expected, now that she was at her peak, she had caught someone's attention. They wanted to use her family to control her.

Xiangjun called for Xiao Luzi. "Go and invite Lord Tingxue here."

chapters.title: Reconciliation
chapters.content:
Before Xiao Luzi could go find her, Gu Tingxue arrived and immediately told Xiangjun about the situation in Jiangnan.

"This case was handled by Song Feijing's subordinates."

"Did my brother really cheat?"

Gu Tingxue shook his head. "I sent someone to investigate. Your brother is indeed talented. With his abilities, passing the imperial examinations to become a Juren should not be difficult. The cheating must be a setup by someone else."

Xiangjun cursed, "This Song Feijing is truly the Empress's dog! Just because I gained the Emperor's favor and stole the Empress's limelight, he has to come after me!"

After thinking for a moment, she asked, "Would it help if I plead with the Emperor?"

"Exam cheating is a serious crime. The Emperor cannot show favoritism just for you. Moreover, Song Feijing has the support of the Jiangnan faction, and his influence there is deeply rooted. Without a good reason, even I cannot interfere too much."

In her previous life, the Xu family had all been imprisoned due to the illegal salt trade, so naturally, Xu Huanwen had not been able to take the imperial examinations afterward.

Xiangjun had never expected that there would be a scholarly person in her family.

This adopted brother, with no blood relation, was someone Xiangjun had to save.

The biggest difference between her and the other concubines in the palace was her family background. If she could have a capable person from the previous dynasty in her family, combined with the Emperor's favor she enjoyed, she would soon be able to truly secure her position.

By then, she would no longer need to rely so much on Gu Tingxue.

Xiangjun gritted her teeth. "Then I have no choice but to beg Empress Guifei."

...

Xiangjun went to Ganlu Palace and knelt before Empress Guifei, crying and kowtowing until even Rong Guifei felt the pain.

Xiangjun expressed her willingness to follow Guifei's lead, only asking Guifei to save her brother.

"Your Highness, this concubine's brother is definitely not a cheater. He has been talented since he was young. He must have been framed."

Rong Guifei believed this. Xiangjun's excellent handwriting also showed the deep literary heritage of the Xu family.

Guifei also suspected that this might have been done by Song Feijing for her sake.

"Alright, get up first and tell me slowly."

Xiangjun refused to get up and continued to cry bitterly.

"Your Highness, this concubine has no family background, and there is no one in the previous dynasty who can speak for my brother. I beg Your Highness to save my brother. Xiangjun is willing to lay down her life for Your Highness! I only ask that my brother's case be handled fairly. Please, Your Highness."

Caiwei, standing beside Guifei, looked at Xiangjun with satisfaction.

No matter how favored a concubine was, in front of Guifei, she still had to kneel and beg for mercy.

Guifei, however, had a soft heart and promised Xiangjun that she would think of a way.

"Caiwei, you help me see Lian Deyi off."

Caiwei escorted Xiangjun out of Ganlu Palace.

Seeing Xiangjun's disoriented state, Caiwei reminded her, "Guifei has been good to Lian Deyi. Lian Deyi should also do her best for Guifei."

Xiangjun immediately said to Caiwei, "I also want to do my best for Guifei. As long as there is an opportunity, I will persuade the Emperor to visit Guifei. However... Caiwei, there are some things I cannot ask Guifei directly, but I truly want to help Guifei. Please give me a straightforward answer."

"Guifei can tell you directly."

"Why did the Emperor, who used to favor Guifei the most, stop staying overnight at Ganlu Palace for more than half a year? I have asked the Emperor, but he was evasive, as if there was some taboo... Do you know the reason, Caiwei? Only if you tell me can I think of a way to help Guifei."

Caiwei hesitated for a moment, thinking that Lian Deyi was so good at gaining favor, perhaps she had a way to make Guifei regain the Emperor's affection. So, she took Xiangjun to a secluded place and told her the situation.

Xiangjun pretended to think for a moment, then said, "I have a guess, but I don't know if it's correct..."

"Deyi Consort, just say it."

"Perhaps the Emperor was scared."

"Scared by what?"

"You said that the Emperor entered the delivery room... Perhaps the Emperor accidentally saw the scene of Guifei giving birth... This left a shadow on him. So, although he often visits Guifei, he refuses to stay overnight or summon her again."

Caiwei also had a sudden realization.

That was indeed a possibility.

"What can we do? Can this be remedied?"

"The Emperor has already seen it, and we cannot make him forget. But in such matters, as long as the Emperor and Guifei have the first time and break through this mental barrier, everything will be fine afterward."

"But the Emperor is unwilling. Can we force the Emperor to favor Guifei?"

Xiangjun thought for a moment. "I do have a way."

Xiangjun whispered a few words into Caiwei's ear.

Caiwei hesitated but still listened to Xiangjun's words.

"If you can help Guifei, Guifei will certainly remember your kindness."

Xiangjun quickly took out a bag of gold beans from her sleeve and gave it to Caiwei.

"Your Highness, this is not appropriate."

"Caiwei, please accept it. I also need you to speak more kind words for me, so that Guifei can help my brother. The lives of my entire family are now in Guifei's hands. Please speak up for me, Caiwei."

Caiwei thought for a moment and finally accepted the bag of gold beans.

"As long as Lian Deyi can help our Guifei, how can Guifei forget Deyi's kindness?"

...

The next day, Xiangjun sent several jars of ointment to Rong Guifei.

It was a secret medicine from Jiangnan, specially used for women's special parts. After giving birth, it was inevitable that things would look unsightly. With this secret medicine, women could recover as before.

Meng Mei was somewhat reluctant. "Your Highness is being too generous. This medicine is worth a thousand gold."

"I need her to save my brother, so naturally, I have to be generous. Moreover, with Rong Guifei's temperament, asking her to serve in such a way would probably make her feel ashamed to death."

...

As Xiangjun expected, Rong Guifei initially refused to use the medicine. But after much persuasion from Caiwei, she finally used it, feeling ashamed and indignant.

She felt a deep sorrow, and even the beautiful love between her and the Emperor had developed cracks in her heart.

Now, doing such things to try to regain the Emperor's favor, how was this any different from those lowly prostitutes?

But she had no choice. She did not want the Emperor to never favor her again for the rest of his life.

...

Finally, Xiangjun persuaded the Emperor to go to Ganlu Palace again.

Although Rong Guifei was ashamed and indignant, she still did as Xiangjun said.

Caiwei, waiting outside, finally felt at ease.

The next morning, the Emperor left in high spirits.

Caiwei happily entered to attend to Guifei's washing, only to see Guifei crying with her face covered.

chapters.title: Nanyue Gu Poison
chapters.content:
Caiwei immediately approached.

"Your Highness, the Emperor has reconciled with you. Why are you still crying?"

"Caiwei, the Emperor's treatment of me is ultimately different from before."

Previously, Rong Guifei had thought she was different from the other concubines in the harem. Now, she felt she was no different from them, having to try every means to please the Emperor and seek his pity.

"Your Highness, the Emperor's treatment of you is different. It's just that you and the Emperor have been married for many years, and things cannot remain unchanged forever. Now that you are taking the initiative with the Emperor, it is only because you also have the Emperor in your heart."

Rong Guifei was distracted. "Is that so?"

"Of course it is."

...

In the following days, Rong Guifei seemed to have returned to the time when she was greatly favored by the Emperor. The Emperor and Rong Guifei were as sweet as honey.

Song Feijing also sent a message to Guifei, saying that the Xu family matter was indeed handled by him.

"Feijing has gone too far this time. Exam cheating is a crime punishable by execution and the extermination of the entire family. Lian Deyi's brother is truly wronged."

"This time, it was indeed Lian Deyi who helped the Emperor and you reconcile. Lian Deyi's family is all in Jiangnan, and Jiangnan is entirely under the control of Prime Minister Song. Your Highness, why worry about not being able to control Lian Deyi?"

Rong Guifei sighed. "Send a reply to him, telling him to release Xiangjun's brother and properly appease the Xu family."

Soon after, Xiangjun received a letter from Jiangnan.

It said that not only was her brother released, but he had also turned misfortune into fortune. Song Feijing had written a letter of recommendation, allowing him to come to the capital to study at the Imperial College. Song Feijing said that this was all thanks to Xiangjun's effective service to Guifei in the palace.

Her father expressed his gratitude to Xiangjun in the letter and also sent her many treasures.

However, Xiangjun was still somewhat worried.

She could not let her family get too closely involved with Song Feijing.

But she was afraid that if she replied, her letter might be seen by Song Feijing's people. So, she wrote a letter and asked Gu Tingxue to find a way to deliver it.

Gu Tingxue directly opened and read Xiangjun's letter.

Xiangjun was displeased. "You just opened my letter in front of me?"

"Now that Your Highness has a promising brother, this subject is afraid that he will soon lose Your Highness's favor."

Gu Tingxue quickly finished reading.

"Why don't you want the Xu family to have contact with Prime Minister Song? Jiangnan is Prime Minister Song's territory. If you can get the Song family's help, combined with the Emperor's favor you enjoy in the palace, your family can also secure a place in Jiangnan."

"I am afraid that the Song family will not last that long. Before my family can secure a place in Jiangnan, my family might be implicated."

"But will the Xu family listen to you?"

"They should."

"Why?"

"I know my father very well. He is the most cautious and timid person. I have also told him that I have information he does not know. He will certainly not act recklessly. I am not asking him to offend Prime Minister Song, only to preserve himself and not get too deeply involved."

Gu Tingxue thought for a moment. "Alright, I will have someone remind your father properly. But why do you think the Song family will not last long?"

"The Emperor must have wanted Prime Minister Song dead for a long time. Last time, when Guifei secretly went to visit Prime Minister Song, the thorn in the Emperor's heart was deeply embedded."

"But the Emperor values his imperial power the most. He still needs Prime Minister Song to deal with the Yang family."

Xiangjun naturally knew this, but she also knew that soon, Prime Minister Song would not be able to restrain himself and would make a fatal move when the Emperor went to the summer palace.

...

The Emperor soon learned about Xiangjun's brother entering the capital to study at the Imperial College.

The Emperor summoned Xiangjun to the Taiji Hall and asked about her brother, Xu Huanwen.

The Emperor's intention was for Xiangjun to guide Xu Huanwen well. As long as her brother was promising and could pass the imperial examinations in the spring, the Emperor would promote him.

Xiangjun was overjoyed and thanked the Emperor. The Emperor's intention was to promote her family.

Xiangjun was returning to her palace in a sedan chair when she encountered a newly entered concubine halfway.

Xiangjun recognized her as Jiang Shuyu, Jiang Guiren. Xiangjun remembered her. She was a secret piece arranged by Song Feijing, and even Guifei did not know about her identity.

Speaking of which, Song Feijing really understood Guifei well. Knowing that she was more likely to fail than succeed, he arranged a piece that she did not know about. Otherwise, it would be like the previous concubine sent into the palace, who died muddledly not long after entering.

Jiang Guiren had only served the Emperor once.

But Xiangjun knew that Jiang Guiren had deliberately not tried to gain the Emperor's favor that time. The Emperor actually quite liked her type of beauty, as there had been no such cold and aloof beauties in the palace before.

However, she only had Prime Minister Song in her heart, so she was unwilling to pay attention to the Emperor.

This person caused a lot of trouble later. Not only did she bring down the Empress, but she also became Rong Guifei's biggest rival and the greatest antagonist in the entire story.

In short, she was a ruthless person.

Jiang Guiren greeted Xiangjun.

Xiangjun smiled. "Meeting you today is fate. If you do not mind, you can come to my Chengxiang Palace for a visit."

Jiang Guiren still had her usual cold and indifferent demeanor. "This concubine is not feeling well and fears passing my illness to Deyi Consort."

Jiang Guiren soon took her leave and left.

Xi Rain huffed coldly. "How arrogant. She is just a Guiren, yet she acts so haughty."

Xiangjun was not angry and calmly said, "I was just an adopted daughter at first. We should not look down on others. Who knows, one day she might gain the Emperor's favor. We should not make unnecessary enemies. Let's go."

Xiangjun knew all too well that in her previous life, she had died early because she was too arrogant and had offended people when she was successful.

In this life, as long as no one had offended her, she would not make things difficult for them either.

...

Qin Yue Consort was pregnant, and her father, the King of Nanyue, had entered the capital and received rewards from the Emperor. For a time, he was the center of attention in the palace.

The Emperor allowed the King of Nanyue to enter the palace to see his daughter.

Xiangjun immediately ordered Xiao Luzi to have someone watch Qin Yue Consort's every move.

In her previous life, after Qin Yue Consort met her father, she had the idea of fighting for the position of Crown Prince for her own child. She wanted to take advantage of her father's presence in the capital to get help and eliminate Guifei's child.

Xiangjun's first child, Yuanheng, was raised by Rong Guifei from birth. In her previous life, he had been disfigured by Qin Yue Consort at a young age.

Everyone knew that a disfigured prince could not become the Crown Prince.

Xiangjun was curious whether Qin Yue Consort would do the same thing to the Fourth Prince in this life.

Sure enough, not long after, Xiao Luzi found out that the Fourth Prince was ill. After burning with fever for two days, he fell into a coma...

"What does the imperial physician say?" Xiangjun asked.

"The imperial physician cannot cure it. They say this is not an illness, but poison..." Xiao Luzi lowered his voice. "Prime Minister Song has already found a master of detoxification. The Emperor has sent someone to summon them into the palace overnight to diagnose the Fourth Prince."

Xiangjun was not surprised. Sure enough, Qin Yue Consort had used this trick again.

The Fourth Prince was indeed not ill; he was poisoned by Nanyue's Gu poison.

Xiangjun thought for a moment and decided to play it safe. If something happened to Yuanze, it would not be a bad thing for Xiangjun.

Xiangjun gently touched her belly. She was already one month pregnant. Her most beloved child was about to return to her side.

chapters.title: Do You Have Any Feelings for Me?
chapters.content:
Song Xiang had found the Sacred Hand of Detoxification to enter the capital and neutralize the gu poison, but Yuan Ze was still disfigured.

Yuan Ze’s face was covered in black spots.

Both Song Xiang and the noble consort knew that the one who had poisoned Yuan Ze was Yue Fei, because this gu poison was unique to Nanyue.

But this was not evidence at all; even Song Xiang could not find any proof.

Xiang Jun was familiar with Qin Yue Fei’s methods.

This time, Qin Yue Fei’s father had come to the capital, and with the guidance of his father’s advisors, Qin Yue Fei had indeed left no traces.

The gu poison had been placed in the water used by the Fourth Prince’s wet nurse to wash clothes.

The wet nurse’s undergarments were contaminated with the poison, which then infected the Fourth Prince through breastfeeding.

Because this method left no traces and the dose was very small, the Fourth Prince managed to survive.

Xiang Jun could only consider herself lucky that, once Qin Yue Fei gave birth, the King of Nanyue would return, otherwise, if he stayed to help his daughter, Qin Yue Fei would be even harder to deal with.

...

Yuan Ze was the only child the noble consort had in this life.

After much thought, the noble consort realized she still couldn’t handle this on her own and had to ask Song Feijing to help her take revenge.

Song Feijing quickly arranged for a beautiful woman to enter the palace, who gained the emperor’s favor.

This beauty was chosen to resemble Xiang Jun and Qing Lian, of the same type.

Although she was inferior to Xiang Jun in every aspect, her novelty was her advantage.

After experiencing Xiang Jun and Qing Lian, the emperor had grown tired of the usual ways the palace concubines served him and preferred this bold and unrestrained style. So, he still favored her several times.

Xiang Jun knew why this concubine had entered the palace, so she had no interest in competing with her.

What was the point of fighting with someone who was doomed to die?

Xiang Jun had been pregnant for only a month, but she dared not reveal it, telling only Gu Tingxue.

Because the emperor still visited her often, and he played wildly with her. Moreover, she knew that the beauty sent by Prime Minister Song had secretly given the emperor a potion.

The emperor was now poisoned with a strange toxin. This poison did not harm the emperor’s body, but it would cause harm to those close to him, especially pregnant women.

The poison was specifically targeting the child in Consort Qin’s womb.

As long as the emperor favored Consort Qin a few more times, her child would be lost.

Xiang Jun was only one month along, at her most unstable. If she were to welcome the emperor in this state, it might harm the child in her womb.

Gu Tingxue had no choice but to try every means to make the emperor forget about Xiang Jun and Qing Lian, so during these days, the emperor visited the new favorite the most.

Qing Lian didn’t know why Xiang Jun had suddenly stopped competing for favor, but seeing that her sister no longer sought the emperor’s attention, she naturally stood in solidarity with her sister, staying in her own palace day after day to guard her Yuan Ji.

For a long time, neither Xiang Jun nor Qing Lian received the emperor’s summons.

This pregnancy was very stable for Xiang Jun. This second child was here to repay a debt of gratitude; in her past life, he had been the most well-behaved, devoted solely to her.

Xiang Jun ate and slept well every day. Just after finishing dinner, Xi Ru entered to report that Chen Gengyi had brought gifts to visit the noble consort.

“Chen Gengyi?”

Chen Gengyi was the beauty Prime Minister Song had just sent into the palace.

Xiang Jun originally didn’t want to see her, but then Xi Ru continued, “She said she was passing by and delivering rewards from Noble Consort to you.”

Passing by? Hardly.

Xiang Jun had no choice; she couldn’t refuse the noble consort’s face, so she had no choice but to invite Chen Gengyi in.

Chen Gengyi’s temperament was quite similar to Xiang Jun’s in her past life—bold, proud, and a bit vulgar from poor upbringing. Xiang Jun even found it strangely familiar.

But knowing that the visitor had ill intentions, Xiang Jun naturally didn’t dare to keep her long. After a few polite exchanges and expressing her appreciation for the noble consort’s gifts, she found an excuse to send her guest away.

But Xiang Jun had underestimated the newly arrived beauty. Not long after Chen Gengyi left, Xiang Jun began to feel something was wrong. Her whole body was hot and restless, her breathing rapid, and her head began to spin.

Xiang Jun, as a Yangzhou courtesan, was familiar with various aphrodisiacs. She quickly realized she had been drugged with a spring medicine.

Where had the drug been administered?

Xiang Jun hurriedly called for Meng Mei and said seriously, “Don’t store the things Chen Gengyi brought yet. Hurry and fetch Physician Liu.”

But as soon as Meng Mei stepped out, a eunuch announced that the emperor had arrived.

Xiang Jun instantly understood Chen Gengyi’s purpose.

If she hadn’t been sensitive to such drugs, by the time the emperor arrived and they were both aroused, she might not have noticed she had been drugged.

But Xiang Jun couldn’t figure out how Chen Gengyi knew about her pregnancy. Or perhaps Chen Gengyi didn’t know and was just taking precautions by arranging this?

Xiang Jun had no time to think it through; the emperor was already entering.

Naturally, Xiang Jun couldn’t refuse the emperor. She could only mess up her hair a bit, feigning a weary look, and sit by the bed.

When the emperor entered, she pretended to have just woken up and went forward to greet him.

Seeing Xiang Jun in this state, the emperor asked concerningly, “What’s wrong? Why did you go to bed so early?”

Xiang Jun held her forehead. “I have a terrible headache, and I seem to have a fever.”

The emperor reached out to touch her forehead, which was indeed a bit hot.

But for some reason, Xiang Jun’s flushed face was even more alluring. He took her hand. “I’ll stay with you. Xiao Chunzi, go fetch the imperial physician.”

“Meng Mei has already gone to get him. I seem to be ill, and I don’t dare pass my sickness to Your Majesty. Perhaps Your Majesty should rest elsewhere.”

“The dragon’s aura in me will protect me. You’re just a little feverish; it won’t affect me.”

The emperor didn’t want to leave, but Xiang Jun absolutely couldn’t welcome him at this time. Just as she was thinking of a reason to send the emperor away, Xi Ru entered, followed by Aunt Zhu Jin.

Aunt Zhu Jin said, “Your Majesty, Consort Yue has suddenly developed abdominal pain and wishes for Your Majesty to visit her.”

Qin Yue Fei hated Xiang Jun the most. These days, since the emperor hadn’t visited Xiang Jun, she had been quite pleased with herself. So, upon hearing that the emperor had gone to Chengxiang Hall, she immediately sent someone to summon him.

Qin Yue Fei certainly didn’t want Xiang Jun to seduce the emperor again.

Xiang Jun had never been so grateful to Qin Yue Fei. She immediately expressed her magnanimity, urging the emperor to go be with Consort Yue.

The emperor had no choice. He had missed Xiang Jun somewhat, but the imperial lineage was more important, so he went to Nanxun Hall.

Not long after the emperor left, Physician Liu arrived. After diagnosing Xiang Jun, he determined that Chen Gengyi must have used some trick when speaking with Xiang Jun, causing her to inhale the drug.

“Your Highness cannot take medicine now. Fortunately, this drug does not cause much harm to the body; it only induces arousal. Your Highness should endure it. Once the drug’s effects wear off, you’ll be fine.”

Xiang Jun had no choice but to dismiss everyone and then called for Xiao Luzi, ordering him to find a way to bring Gu Tingxue to her.

Gu Tingxue knew that the emperor had gone to Xiang Jun’s place today, so she had someone send a message to Nanxun Hall, and as expected, the emperor was called away by Consort Yue.

Unexpectedly, late at night, Xiang Jun sent someone to fetch her again.

Gu Tingxue, worried that something might happen to Xiang Jun and her child, didn’t dare delay and immediately went to Chengxiang Hall.

When Gu Tingxue arrived, the palace gates were already locked. Inside Xiang Jun’s room, there was only Xiang Jun herself; even Meng Mei and Xi Ru had been dismissed.

Gu Tingxue sensed something was wrong. She hurried to the bedside and saw Xiang Jun lying on the bed with her eyes closed, her face flushed. She reached out to touch her.

“Why are you so hot? You should have called for a physician.”

Gu Tingxue turned to go find a physician, but suddenly, someone hugged her tightly from behind.

“Tingxue, do you have any feelings for me at all?”

---

chapters.title: Detoxification
chapters.content:
Gu Tingxue’s body stiffened, his voice a little hoarse. “Your Highness...”

The arms around his waist were tight, but he still managed to grab the restless little hand and pull it away forcefully.

But as soon as he turned around, Xiang Jun pounced on him again.

She was really persistent.

Xiang Jun even stood on her tiptoes and kissed him.

Before Xiang Jun could get close, Gu Tingxue had already pushed her away and quickly realized something was wrong with Xiang Jun.

Gu Tingxue frowned. “Who gave you the drug?”

Xiang Jun looked aggrieved, clinging to Gu Tingxue. “Chen Gengyi.”

Gu Tingxue grabbed Xiang Jun’s restless hands, his breathing somewhat disordered.

“Your Highness, I’ll call someone to detoxify you. Behave yourself and stop moving around.”

Xiang Jun exhaled hot breath onto him, pressing her lips close to Gu Tingxue’s, sighing, “I’ve already consulted Physician Liu. He said taking medicine would be bad for the child in my womb.”

Gu Tingxue pushed Xiang Jun’s face away. “Then Your Highness should listen to the physician. Endure it properly. Tingxue won’t disturb you any longer; I’ll take my leave.”

How could Xiang Jun let him go? She tightly grabbed Gu Tingxue’s sleeve.

“Tingxue, I don’t want to endure it. Won’t you help me?”

Gu Tingxue looked at Xiang Jun, who was only wearing her undergarments, her fragrant shoulders slightly exposed, and felt that uncontrollable heat rise within him again.

“What does Your Highness mean by this?”

“Don’t pretend you don’t understand. Do you really not know what I want you to do?”

Gu Tingxue clenched his fists, his throat itching. He lowered his eyes to look at Xiang Jun’s watery gaze and lowered his voice. “Why must Your Highness humiliate me like this?”

“How am I humiliating you?” Xiang Jun was urgent. “Does being with me mean I’ve insulted Tingxue?”

“Does Your Highness not consider me just a toy for your amusement?”

“Of course not. If I wanted a toy for amusement, couldn’t I find a few pretty little eunuchs in the palace? Why would I wait for you all this time? If it weren’t for the need to bear the emperor’s child, I wouldn’t even want to touch him.”

Seeing Gu Tingxue’s expression soften slightly, Xiang Jun’s eyes filled with spring water as she hugged the unprepared Gu Tingxue again.

“Tingxue, I don’t believe you have no true feelings for me at all. If you didn’t, why did you come to save me back then at the Palace Rectification Office?”

Gu Tingxue had never met such an unreasonable woman. She didn’t love him at all, only used him bluntly, yet she insisted on having his heart. She was truly powerful, selfish, and shameless.

Gu Tingxue suppressed the surging emotions in his chest and asked, “Your Highness wants my true heart, but what about Your Highness’s true heart? You don’t have any true feelings for Tingxue, only exploitation.”

Xiang Jun felt no shame at all, her fair legs hooking around Gu Tingxue.

“True feelings? I don’t have any. I don’t love any man in this world. But I trust you, Tingxue. I consider you someone I can entrust my life and family to, someone I’m willing to walk to the end with. Isn’t that special enough?”

Gu Tingxue gave a cold laugh.

Sure enough, she was a cold-hearted and emotionless woman. To say she didn’t love any man so casually—she was indeed honest.

It was a pity, Gu Tingxue thought, that he wasn’t a man.

“Tingxue, would you be willing to cherish me a little?”

Xiang Jun shamelessly clung to him again.

From the first time Gu Tingxue saw Xiang Jun, he knew that this woman would stop at nothing to get what she wanted. No matter what it was, she would scheme, use any means necessary, shamelessly, to obtain it.

Looking at the hand that was causing trouble on his body, Gu Tingxue restrained himself and grabbed it tightly.

Gu Tingxue endured until the veins on his neck were bulging.

All along, he had been suppressing that restless feeling in his heart. It felt like anger, or perhaps anxiety, even making his chest ache and his whole body tremble.

But this feeling was both strange and intriguing to Gu Tingxue.

Later, many times, Gu Tingxue vaguely realized that Xiang Jun could alleviate this pain.

No matter how much Xiang Jun invited him, Gu Tingxue never took a step forward.

Because he was afraid he wouldn’t be able to control himself.

Xiang Jun had no true feelings, so Gu Tingxue was also unwilling to love first.

“Your Highness seems to have forgotten—Tingxue is a eunuch, not a man.”

“So what?” Xiang Jun’s breath was like orchids. “It’s just that I can’t have children. As long as you want to, can’t Tingxue give me pleasure?”

Physical pleasure?

He really could.

He suddenly remembered something Xiang Jun had said before: she didn’t want physical pleasure because, as her wet nurse said, women could easily fall in love with a man because of it.

He also remembered Xiang Jun saying that he had a pair of beautiful hands.

Gu Tingxue wanted to make a bet with Xiang Jun—whoever lost would have to give their heart.

“Fine.” Gu Tingxue suddenly said.

Xiang Jun was a little surprised; she had thought she’d have to wear him down a bit more.

In a daze, Xiang Jun was lifted up by Gu Tingxue.

She immediately reached out and wrapped her arms around Gu Tingxue’s neck.

“Tingxue...”

Xiang Jun’s voice was so soft it seemed it could drip water.

“Your Highness, even if you regret it now, it’s too late.”

...

When Gu Tingxue returned to the Seal Office, he ran into his apprentice, Wan Lichun.

Xiao Chunzi was already used to his master’s habit of being out all night. Seeing his master return covered in the morning’s cold air and dew, yet without the usual cold aura, instead exuding a gentle warmth like a spring breeze, he said:

“Master, you’re back early today.” Wan Lichun’s gaze fell on his master’s qilin robe. “Master, what happened to your clothes? Did someone spill tea on them? Let me wash them for you.”

Gu Tingxue looked down at his clothes and smiled pleasantly, the corners of his mouth lifting.

“No need. You should go attend to His Majesty.”

After his master left, Wan Lichun stared at his master’s retreating figure for a long time before coming back to his senses.

What good thing had happened to his master today? Why was he in such a good mood?

Could it be that His Majesty had given Master another good assignment?

chapters.title: First Meeting with the Prince of Jin
chapters.content:
Dream Mei wanted to wake Xiang Jun, but Xiang Jun truly couldn’t get up in the morning.

Fortunately, Physician Liu had visited the day before, so Dream Mei requested three days of leave from the Empress Dowager, and Xiang Jun did not go to pay respects to the Empress.

Xiang Jun didn’t wake up until the afternoon. The moment she did, she cursed Gu Tingxue fiercely, then ordered Dream Mei to summon Physician Liu.

Physician Liu diagnosed her again, his expression unchanging, and said, "Your Highness, the effects of the medicine have already worn off. Just be more careful in the future."

"This matter still unsettles me." Xiang Jun asked doubtfully, "Why would Concubine Chen want to harm me?"

Physician Liu immediately replied, "This humble official already investigated yesterday. There are people loyal to Song Feijing in the Imperial Physicians' Office. I suspect they discovered that the medicine I prescribed for Your Highness contained ingredients for stabilizing pregnancy."

Xiang Jun frowned with worry. "There’s a saying: a thief can steal for a thousand days, but cannot guard against theft for a thousand days. Dream Mei, go and summon Noble Consort Li for me."

After Noble Consort Li arrived, Xiang Jun had Physician Liu explain the matter regarding Concubine Chen to her.

Noble Consort Li's expression changed drastically. "Sister, this is a serious matter. We must not get involved. What Concubine Chen did harms the imperial body—that is a capital offense! And she is under the protection of Minister Song. We must pretend we know nothing."

"I also want to pretend I know nothing, but she tried to harm me."

"But the poison she used was not..." Li Qinglian was clever and quickly realized. She gasped, "Sister, you..."

Xiang Jun nodded. "I have been pregnant for a month."

Noble Consort Li took a deep breath, then grabbed Xiang Jun’s hand, her emotions a mix of joy and worry. "Sister, do not worry. I am in the same palace as you, and I am not pregnant either. From now on, if His Majesty comes again, you can have him come to my palace. I will never let anything happen to you or the child in your womb."

"You don’t ask why I don’t tell His Majesty the truth?"

"Sister has her reasons. I don’t care much for His Majesty anyway."

Xiang Jun had Dream Mei escort Noble Consort Li back first, then asked Physician Liu to give her a diagnosis, saying she had caught a cold the previous night and could not attend to the Emperor for the next few months.

Physician Liu agreed.

Xiang Jun pondered for a moment, then dismissed everyone in the palace except Physician Liu.

After everyone had left, Xiang Jun lowered her voice and asked, "Physician Liu, do you want to become the Director of the Imperial Physicians' Office?"

Physician Liu did not hide his ambition. As someone of humble origins from a brothel, he had seen enough of the struggles at the bottom and had longed to rise above his station through his own abilities since he was young.

"Your Highness, this humble official naturally wishes to, but the Imperial Physicians' Office values seniority the most. I am an outsider, and apart from the favor of Noble Consort Gui, I have no influence of my own in the Imperial Physicians' Office. How could I possibly become the Director?"

"If you want it, this palace naturally has a way. Right now, I have a way to elevate your position in the Imperial Physicians' Office, but it is somewhat dangerous. I just don’t know if you dare to take the risk."

Physician Liu answered without hesitation, "This humble official is willing to take the risk."

...

After that day, Xiang Jun did not see Gu Tingxue for a long time.

In the past, if she had gone this long without seeing Gu Tingxue, she would have gone to find him.

But for some reason, she felt that she didn’t want to see Gu Tingxue much these days.

In the past, although Xiang Jun was uninhibited in bed, with no words she dared not say and no actions she dared not take, everything was carefully calculated by her. Even every expression, every glance, and the direction in which sweat fell were all deliberate.

But last time with Gu Tingxue...

For a moment, she had been completely unaware and lost her rationality.

At that time, she had completely entrusted herself to Gu Tingxue.

Xiang Jun did not like this feeling; in fact, she found it frightening.

Having lived again, she had almost everything under her control.

She did not like this feeling of complete loss of control.

Fortunately, not long after, Gu Tingxue was sent out of the palace by the Emperor, and Xiang Jun breathed a sigh of relief.

...

Time passed until the fourth month.

Consort Qin’s belly was already very large.

This year, the heat came early. Additionally, after the war in the south ended, the national treasury had become quite abundant. The Emperor, considering that the Empress Dowager’s health was not at its best, decided to go to the Xiyuan Summer Palace earlier to escape the heat.

This time, the Emperor planned to stay at the Summer Palace for four months, bringing along court officials, as well as the concubines from the harem, servants, guards, imperial troops, and supply convoys. The total number of people going to the Summer Palace was nearly one hundred thousand.

After leaving the capital, the caravan traveled for half a month before finally arriving at the Xiyuan Summer Palace in mid-April.

The Xiyuan Summer Palace was extremely beautiful.

One day, the weather was particularly fine. Xiang Jun took Qinglian and the Third Prince to see the Emperor. The Emperor invited Xiang Jun to stroll through the gardens with him. As soon as they left the Emperor’s palace, Xiang Jun saw Minister Zhou, who had just come on duty.

Perhaps because he was in a good mood due to the presence of his beautiful concubine and young son, the Emperor was inspired by the matchmaker’s thoughts and declared that he would grant a marriage to Zhou Zidu.

Unexpectedly, Zhou Zidu refused.

"Your humble official has not yet achieved any meritorious deeds. I still wish to one day fight on the battlefield for Your Majesty. Before that, I do not wish to marry."

Seeing the Emperor’s expression change slightly, seemingly displeased, Xiang Jun quickly tried to smooth things over for Zhou Zidu.

"Minister Zhou is waiting to earn military merits so that Your Majesty can grant him a good marriage."

Xiang Jun gave Zhou Zidu a meaningful look. Only then did Zhou Zidu understand and immediately say, "When Zidu has achieved merits for Your Majesty in the future, I will request Your Majesty to grant the marriage."

The Emperor finally nodded. "Good. Zidu has such aspirations, and I will certainly give you this opportunity. You just wait."

The Emperor took Xiang Jun and Qinglian away. While Qinglian was talking to the Emperor, Xiang Jun looked back at Zhou Zidu.

Zhou Zidu looked deeply at Xiang Jun, then lowered his head.

Xiang Jun thought that soon the Emperor would send Zhou Zidu to the northern border. When he returned, he would be a formidable force in the military.

Xiang Jun turned her head again, intending to speak to the Emperor, but her gaze met another pair of eyes.

It was Gu Tingxue.

When had Gu Tingxue arrived?

For some reason, Xiang Jun quickly averted her gaze.

Gu Tingxue had come to find the Emperor for some matter, so the Emperor could no longer stroll through the garden. Xiang Jun and Qinglian went to explore the garden on their own.

After walking for a while, Yuanji became sleepy. Qinglian took the Third Prince back to rest first, while Xiang Jun continued to stroll through the garden with Xiao Luzi and Xiyu.

Xiang Jun had been cooped up in the palace for too long and wanted to enjoy the outdoors. As she fanned herself, she noticed two people in a pavilion: a young servant and a man in a light blue robe sitting in a wheelchair.

Judging by the embroidery on his clothes, he must be a prince. Although he was seated, he still exuded a refined and elegant demeanor, appearing scholarly and charming. He looked to be in his early thirties.

Xiang Jun knew that there was only one disabled prince—the Emperor’s elder brother, the former Crown Prince, the noble concubine’s broken-legged white moon, now known as His Highness, the Prince of Jin—Zhou Qingheng.

After Prince Jin broke his leg, he had been traveling around. He had only recently returned to the capital because of Yuanze’s illness, as he had a renowned physician by his side.

To display his imperial grace, the Emperor had ordered all his brothers to accompany him to the Summer Palace this time. Although he disliked Prince Jin, he could not exclude him alone.

Xiang Jun approached and bowed. "Greetings, Your Highness, Prince of Jin."

Xiang Jun looked at Prince Jin and found him much more handsome than the Emperor.

Tsk, Noble Consort Gui truly had remarkable fortune in beauty.

Prince Jin exuded a gentle charm that was soothing to the heart. Even his voice was warm and mellow. "May I ask which noble consort you are from the palace?"

"In response to Your Highness, Prince of Jin, I am His Majesty’s beloved De Instrument, Xiang Jun."

Prince Jin was somewhat surprised and smiled gently. "So you are De Instrument Xiang Jun. I have had the fortune to see De Instrument’s calligraphy. You are different from what I imagined."

"Oh? What did Your Highness imagine Xiang Jun to be like?"

"Quiet and beautiful, graceful like a gentle breeze. Standing apart from the world, with a lingering charm."

They said that one’s calligraphy reflected one’s character, but Xiang Jun’s handwriting was an imitation of her master’s.

Her master’s calligraphy truly reflected his character—standing apart from the world. Unfortunately, Xiang Jun was ambitious and worldly.

"Xiang Jun has disappointed Your Highness."

Prince Jin shook his head, still smiling gently. "Your Highness, with your stunning beauty and captivating smile, you are naturally wonderful."

Xiang Jun smiled, unable to hide her pleasure. This Prince Jin was quite the flatterer.

"Greetings, Your Highness, Prince of Jin."

A voice suddenly came from behind. Xiang Jun turned abruptly and saw that Gu Tingxue had somehow appeared and was standing at the pavilion.

---

chapters.title: Consort Yue Loses Her Child
chapters.content:
Gu Tingxue strode to the front of the pavilion and said to Prince Jin, "Your Highness, Prince of Jin, His Majesty invites you to play chess. He is waiting for you at the Tianwang Hall."

Prince Jin did not dare to delay. He bade farewell to Xiang Jun and hurried off.

Before leaving, Gu Tingxue shot Xiang Jun a fierce glare.

That evening, the Emperor went to console the displeased Consort Qin Yue. Xiang Jun had many plans for her visit to the Summer Palace, so she retired early.

As soon as Xiang Jun lay down, Dream Mei went to rest on the large bed in the outer room. The curtain of Xiang Jun’s bed was suddenly lifted.

Xiang Jun opened her eyes and, as expected, saw Gu Tingxue.

Xiang Jun propped herself up, her thick, black hair cascading down, giving her a rare touch of gentleness.

"Tingxue, you finally deign to come to my place?" Xiang Jun said lazily.

Gu Tingxue coldly snorted, "Your Highness probably doesn’t want to see Tingxue either. These past two months, I haven’t seen Your Highness send someone to summon me. It seems Your Highness has found a new love and no longer needs to pass the time with Tingxue."

Xiang Jun let out a soft laugh and extended her hand toward Gu Tingxue.

Gu Tingxue instinctively reached out and took Xiang Jun’s hand.

Xiang Jun’s face was filled with a smile. "Why do I smell jealousy? Tingxue, you certainly know how to talk. Where would I find a new love?"

Gu Tingxue’s expression darkened. "Isn’t Minister Zhou enough? Now Your Highness has even taken a fancy to Prince Jin?"

Xiang Jun sighed as if it were a pity. "Prince Jin belongs to Noble Consort Gui. How would I dare?"

"If Prince Jin did not belong to Noble Consort Gui, would you dare?"

Xiang Jun lifted her chin, her gaze bold and arrogant. "Am I joking? Do you believe that, Tingxue? Don’t you know me well? I am very bold and there is nothing I dare not do. Even if he belongs to Noble Consort Gui, or even to the Empress, if I take a fancy to him, I would dare to fight for him."

Seeing Gu Tingxue’s face darken and his gaze turn dangerous, Xiang Jun finally got up, knelt on the bed, and wrapped her hand around Gu Tingxue’s neck.

She whispered in Gu Tingxue’s ear, "So, it’s not that I dare not, it’s that I do not wish to."

Gu Tingxue instinctively swallowed, lowering his voice to ask, "Why don’t you wish to?"

Xiang Jun tilted her head, looking at Gu Tingxue, her fingers lightly tracing his lips.

"Prince Jin is indeed handsome, but he is already middle-aged. I still prefer someone closer to my age. Tingxue, you are just the right age."

Gu Tingxue’s ears turned red again.

Recently, he couldn’t resist her teasing. The image of holding Xiang Jun from last time replayed in his mind. Gu Tingxue acted on impulse, picking Xiang Jun up again and heading toward Noble Consort Gui’s couch.

"Don’t..." Xiang Jun pulled at Gu Tingxue.

Gu Tingxue frowned. "What’s wrong?"

"If we go there, Dream Mei might hear us. Let’s just stay on the bed."

Gu Tingxue hesitated. He didn’t want to do it on the bed.

But Xiang Jun had already started unbuttoning his official robe. Gu Tingxue, as if bewitched, let Xiang Jun pull him onto the bed.

However, Gu Tingxue only allowed his outer robe to be removed and refused to let Xiang Jun take off any more.

Xiang Jun did not force him. She knew some things couldn’t be rushed; she had to give Gu Tingxue time to adjust.

Xiang Jun wrapped her arms around Gu Tingxue’s neck and kissed him.

They had not kissed last time; this was their first kiss.

Gu Tingxue was initially startled, but gradually he became passionate. In the end, Xiang Jun felt as if she might faint from his kisses.

...

Xiang Jun lay contentedly on the bed.

Gu Tingxue maintained his cold and detached demeanor, wearing only his inner robe, standing by the bed and washing his hands in a basin.

He had learned from experience; he had to take off his outer robe, otherwise someone might see it and have to help him wash his clothes.

Xiang Jun looked at Gu Tingxue’s cold and enchanting face and felt a sense of imbalance in her heart.

Why was he so calm?

So, Xiang Jun hugged Gu Tingxue from behind, her hand slipping into his inner robe.

When her hand touched Gu Tingxue’s chest, Xiang Jun’s subtle sense of imbalance disappeared.

"Tingxue’s heart is beating so fast, yet your face shows nothing." Xiang Jun blew a breath into Gu Tingxue’s ear and whispered, "You’re really good at pretending."

Gu Tingxue’s ears reddened slightly. He lowered his gaze, put the handkerchief into his clothes, and stood up to leave.

"Where are you going?"

"I need to go back."

"It’s still early."

Xiang Jun’s hand wrapped around Gu Tingxue’s neck again. Gu Tingxue felt as if she were a clinging snake, very persistent.

"Usually it’s Tingxue attending to me. Today, let me attend to Tingxue once. How about it? I’m very good at it."

Xiang Jun knew how to attend to a eunuch, but Gu Tingxue always refused. Xiang Jun found it strange. She could clearly sense that Gu Tingxue had needs, so why did he refuse?

Could it be that he was too shy?

Gu Tingxue’s eyes darkened, but he still refused. "No need. I will come see Your Highness when I have time."

Gu Tingxue broke free from Xiang Jun’s hand and went to get his clothes. Xiang Jun immediately snatched them and helped Gu Tingxue put them on.

"Your Highness..."

"If you won’t let me attend to you in that way, letting me help you dress is fine, right?"

Gu Tingxue had no choice but to let Xiang Jun dress him.

For a moment, Gu Tingxue even had an illusion that he and she were an ordinary couple.

However, Xiao Luzi’s voice from outside quickly shattered Gu Tingxue’s fantasy.

Xiao Luzi said in the outer room, "Your Highness, it’s not good! Consort Yue has started bleeding!"

Gu Tingxue and Xiang Jun exchanged a glance immediately.

"What happened?" Xiang Jun asked.

"His Majesty stayed with Consort Yue tonight. In the middle of the night, Her Highness suddenly started bleeding. There was blood all over the bed, which scared His Majesty. Now the physicians are there, trying to induce labor..."

"What about Her Majesty the Empress and Noble Consort Gui?"

"They should have been notified."

"I understand. You two wait outside and send someone to inform Noble Consort Li."

Gu Tingxue had already finished dressing and putting on his shoes. He left directly through the window. Only then did Xiang Jun call Dream Mei and Xiyu to help her dress and do her hair.

When she arrived at Consort Yue’s place with Noble Consort Li, all the high-ranking consorts in the palace had already gathered.

Noble Consort Gui glanced at Xiang Jun, who immediately led Noble Consort Li to stand beside Noble Consort Gui.

The Emperor sat there with a dark expression. The atmosphere in the room was heavy, and no one dared to speak. All they could hear were the horrifying screams of Consort Yue coming from the inner room, one after another.

After half an hour, the physician finally came out and reported nervously, "Consort Yue has given birth to a stillborn child, but fortunately, Her Highness’s life has been saved. However... it is likely that Her Highness will never be able to bear children again."

chapters.title: The Emperor is Poisoned
chapters.content:
Xiangjun had no sympathy for Yue Fei, after all, Yue Fei had tried to kill her time and time again.

She secretly observed the Noble Consort, noticing a flicker of schadenfreude cross her face.

Yue Fei had ruined the Noble Consort's fourth prince, so it was only fair that the Noble Consort caused Yue Fei to lose her unborn child.

Xiangjun tugged at the Noble Consort's sleeve and gave her a meaningful look. The Noble Consort realized her expression was amiss and quickly replaced it with a sorrowful one.

The Emperor wearily closed his eyes. He knew that Yue Fei's child's death was no coincidence.

First, the Empress's legitimate son was murdered, then his beloved Yuan Ze was disfigured, and now Yue Fei had lost her unborn child.

The Emperor glanced at the Noble Consort, who wore a grieving expression. Unfortunately, she was not a good actress, and the Emperor disappointedly averted his gaze.

How could he not know that all of this was connected to the Noble Consort? Whether it was the death of the second prince or Yue Fei's miscarriage, it was likely the work of the Noble Consort and Song Feijing behind the scenes.

But he was unwilling to believe that the woman he loved had become like this.

"Your Majesty, there is something suspicious about Yue Fei's child," the Empress said solemnly.

But the Emperor only wearily waved his hand. "I am tired. We will investigate tomorrow."

The Empress had no choice but to swallow the words she was about to say.

The Noble Consort immediately said, "Your Majesty, let this concubine accompany you back to rest."

But the Emperor did not respond to the Noble Consort. Instead, he looked at Xiangjun. "Xiangjun, I will rest in your quarters."

Xiangjun was surprised.

Huh? Her?

Xiangjun wanted to refuse the Emperor, but she didn't dare. The Emperor was heartbroken and disappointed at the moment. If she made excuses about not feeling well, she would fall out of favor.

However, the Emperor probably wasn't in the mood for intimacy tonight, right?

With this thought, Xiangjun immediately put on a gentle and considerate expression. She stepped forward to help the Emperor up and took him back to her residence in the temporary palace, Qingxia Zhai.

Knowing that the Emperor was sad, Xiangjun didn't dare to speak much. After returning, she attended to the Emperor's washing and resting, then let the Emperor lie on her lap and gave him a massage.

"Xiangjun, what do you think of the Noble Consort?" the Emperor asked with his eyes closed.

This was a difficult question to answer. Xiangjun didn't want to play dumb. She had made up her mind to be the Emperor's blade, so she needed to be considerate and understand the Emperor's intentions.

But she also couldn't speak ill of the Noble Consort, as the Emperor still had feelings for her.

After a moment of silence, Xiangjun softly said, "Your Majesty, I do not know about other matters, but one thing I am certain of: the Noble Consort's love for Your Majesty is genuine. No one in the palace can compare to it."

The Emperor's brow seemed to relax a little. He opened his eyes and took Xiangjun's hand, which was massaging his temples.

"Does that include you?" the Emperor asked.

Xiangjun smiled gently. "The Noble Consort and Your Majesty have known each other since you were young. Even if my feelings for Your Majesty are the same as hers, I have still loved Your Majesty for many fewer years than she has."

The Emperor sighed and finally closed his eyes again.

Xiangjun continued to gently massage the Emperor.

"What do you think about Yue Fei's situation?" the Emperor asked again.

It seemed the Emperor was not ready to let her off the hook.

"Yue Fei has always been in good health. This sudden loss of her child... I do not know why it happened. We will have to wait until the matter is investigated before I can form an opinion."

"Today, when Yue Fei lost her child, I saw that all the concubines present had sorrowful expressions. Why were you the only one with no reaction?"

Xiangjun was at a loss and had to think carefully about how to respond.

After a moment, she said, "This concubine truly does not know what expression to use in this situation. To be honest, Yue Fei has tried to harm me so many times, each time trying to kill me. Her loss of the child... I feel like I should be happy. But that was also Your Majesty's child. Your Majesty losing a child makes this concubine sad. My feelings are complicated, and for a moment, I was at a loss."

The Emperor sighed.

"You are indeed sincere."

"This concubine does not dare to deceive Your Majesty in the slightest."

"Yue Fei has harmed you before, and I did not stand up for you. Do you not resent me?"

"How could I?" Xiangjun rarely spoke without a coquettish tone, but now she spoke seriously. "Your Majesty, although this concubine comes from a humble background, my father raised me well from a young age. I have also read many books and understand some principles. Your Majesty is first and foremost the ruler. The country and its people all depend on Your Majesty. Although you are the most noble and powerful person in the world, you cannot do as you please. This concubine only blames herself for causing trouble for Your Majesty and would never want to make things difficult for you."

"Then why don't you seek revenge on Yue Fei, if you resent her?"

"Because this concubine does not know what Your Majesty thinks. If Your Majesty wants to protect someone, even if this concubine dislikes them, I would never harm them."

The Emperor finally fell silent. He sighed heavily and waved his hand, indicating that Xiangjun could stop the massage.

Xiangjun immediately withdrew her hands and helped the Emperor sit up.

The Emperor sat up, his gaze heavy as he looked at Xiangjun.

"Xiangjun, such a simple principle, and yet among all the concubines in the harem, only you understand it. Even the Noble Consort does not understand my difficulties."

The Emperor took Xiangjun's hand. Xiangjun tentatively leaned gently against the Emperor's shoulder.

In the past, Xiangjun had always used her body to captivate the Emperor, but this was the first time she tried to win his heart.

The opportunity was too rare to miss.

The Emperor did not seem displeased by Xiangjun's boldness. Instead, he reached out and pulled her into his embrace.

...

Over the next few days, the Emperor stayed with Xiangjun. Gu Tingxue was sent out of the temporary palace again, no one knew what he was tasked with.

Yue Fei's loss of her child caused quite a commotion. The Emperor visited her a few times, but he couldn't bear to see her hysterical state and stopped going after a while.

He even lamented to Xiangjun, blaming Yue Fei for making a scene and insisting on investigating the truth.

The Emperor clearly did not want to delve deeper into the matter, yet she was making such an unsightly fuss. She truly did not understand how to be considerate.

In the end, the Emperor would hold Xiangjun's hand and sigh, praising her for being understanding and considerate of his feelings.

Xiangjun wanted to curse the Emperor to death in her heart.

Although she hated Qin Yue Fei for repeatedly trying to harm her, she despised the Emperor's coldness, selfishness, and self-centeredness even more.

Fortunately, Yue Fei's outbursts had put the Emperor in a bad mood, and with the busy court affairs, the Emperor only asked Xiangjun to give him massages each time he visited and did not ask her to share his bed.

After staying with Xiangjun for half a month, the Emperor finally went to the Noble Consort's quarters.

Xiangjun finally got a break from attending to him.

Serving the Emperor every day and cautiously answering his difficult questions had exhausted Xiangjun.

Just as she finally got to rest and had just fallen asleep, she was urgently awakened by Xiao Luzi.

Xiao Luzi was truly frightened this time. He knelt on the ground and said in terror, "Noble Consort, it's not good! Something has happened to His Majesty at the Noble Consort's place!"

"What?"

Xiangjun sat up from the bed in surprise.

"What happened?"

"It seems he was poisoned and has fallen into a coma. Her Majesty the Empress has already ordered someone to detain the Noble Consort. Now they are going to invite the ministers to attend to His Majesty..."

Xiangjun immediately had Meng Mei dress her.

Meng Mei asked, "Noble Consort, should we go inform Noble Consort Li?"

"You have Xi Yu take the Third Prince to inform Noble Consort Li. Then have everyone in our palace go to Noble Consort Li's place to guard it. Lock all the palace gates and do not go out. Something is bound to happen today. Xiao Luzi, you come with me to see His Majesty."

Meng Mei worriedly said, "If that's the case, Noble Consort, you shouldn't go out."

"No, I must go."

chapters.title: Forcing the Emperor
chapters.content:
Xiangjun hurried to the Noble Consort's Yu Chun Garden. The Empress had already ordered people to surround the place, preventing anyone from entering. Several high-ranking concubines were waiting at the entrance, blocked from going in.

Fortunately, Zhou Zidu was the one guarding the outside today.

"Commander Zhou, we are truly worried about His Majesty. Please make an exception and let us go in to see him."

The Empress's order was not to let unrelated people in, but it was up to Zhou Zidu to judge who was related in the harem.

Xiangjun was a favored concubine of the Emperor, so it was reasonable for her to want to see him.

Zhou Zidu stepped aside and let Xiangjun in. Xiangjun glanced at the lower-ranking concubines behind her, signaling them to follow. The women gratefully looked at Xiangjun and followed her into Yu Chun Garden.

As soon as Xiangjun and the others entered, they saw Caiwei, who had been beaten to the brink of death. Aunt Chun stood next to Caiwei. When she saw Xiangjun enter, she greeted her.

"Aunt Chun, what happened?"

Aunt Chun answered officially, "His Majesty was poisoned in the Noble Consort's palace. This slave was ordered by Her Majesty the Empress to punish the guilty palace servants. Please, Noble Consort Xiang, go in first."

Xiangjun glanced at Caiwei, who had already lost consciousness.

Without saying more, she led the other concubines into the main hall.

The Empress was seated in the main hall with a formidable presence, guarded by Aunt Fang and a group of palace servants.

The Noble Consort was kneeling on the ground, restrained by two people, and was in tears.

When the Empress saw Xiangjun enter, she remained expressionless. "Since Noble Consort Xiang and the other sisters have come, you may wait to the side."

"Your Majesty the Empress, how is His Majesty?"

"He was poisoned and is in a coma. The imperial physicians are treating him."

Xiangjun glanced at the Noble Consort and said with a worried expression, "The matter has not been investigated yet. Why not let the Noble Consort stand up first..."

The Empress glared at Xiangjun as if she wanted to poke holes in her.

"When did the affairs of the harem become your decision, Noble Consort Xiang?"

"I would not dare."

Xiangjun could only stand to the side and look helplessly at the Noble Consort.

"Yang Fengyi!" the Noble Consort glared at the Empress, saying indignantly, "Are you planning to take advantage of His Majesty's unconsciousness to deal with me? You are framing me! Are you not afraid of being punished by His Majesty when he wakes up? I am the Noble Consort!"

The Empress coldly laughed. "I am the Empress. What does it matter if you are the Noble Consort? I have the authority to deal with you."

With the support of her father, the Empress directly ordered people to cover the Noble Consort's mouth and drag her away to strangle her.

Xiangjun knew that neither the Empress nor Yang Xiang wanted the Noble Consort to live, nor did they intend to let the Emperor live.

But the Noble Consort was more resilient than Xiangjun had thought. She did not cry or wail but glared fiercely at the Empress, struggling as the pearl hairpin fell from her head, showing no sign of submission.

Xiangjun immediately rushed forward and hugged the Noble Consort, kneeling on the ground and pleading, "Your Majesty the Empress, the Noble Consort would never harm His Majesty! You cannot do this to her!"

"The Noble Consort Xiang, why are you so eager to defend the Noble Consort? Are you her accomplice?"

Xiangjun had to stand on the Noble Consort's side at this moment. She cried, "Your Majesty the Empress, why are you so eager to pin all the blame on me and my sister? His Majesty has not yet woken up, and you are already in a hurry to execute someone. What are you afraid of?"

The Empress was furious and slammed the table heavily.

"Enough! Noble Consort Xiang, you are speaking out of turn. You truly do not know your place. Come, take her away and beat her!"

The Noble Consort looked at Xiangjun with tears in her eyes, shaking her head desperately at Xiangjun, signaling her not to interfere.

Someone reached out to grab Xiangjun and dragged her away.

The Empress then looked at the people restraining the Noble Consort and coldly said, "Why are you still waiting?"

Several people dragged the Noble Consort out of the hall. Xiangjun was pressed onto a bench. Caiwei, covered in blood, was thrown to the side. She looked at Xiangjun gratefully, then looked tragically at the other side. Over there, the Noble Consort had been dragged out, and two palace servants had prepared a white silk ribbon, forcefully wrapping it around the Noble Consort's neck.

At this critical moment, an arrow suddenly shot and hit the palace servant restraining the Noble Consort. Immediately after, several more arrows shot and hit the palace servants who were about to punish Xiangjun.

Everyone was thrown into chaos, and the palace servants scrambled to take cover.

Xiangjun quickly crouched down and crawled to the Noble Consort's side, removing the cloth from her mouth.

The Empress, although shocked, remained seated in her position of authority without moving.

"Commander Zhou!" the Empress shouted. "How dare someone shoot arrows when His Majesty is still in the hall!"

As soon as she finished speaking, everyone saw Song Feijing leading the Commander of the Imperial Guards and a group of soldiers rushing into the courtyard.

"I have been ordered to protect the Emperor!"

Yang Xiang immediately led a few elderly ministers out of the main hall, pointing at Song Feijing and cursing, "Traitor! Commander Zhou, why haven't you arrested him yet!"

However, Zhou Zidu stood at the entrance without moving.

The next moment, Song Feijing sheathed his sword and stabbed it into Yang Xiang's chest.

Yang Xiang looked at Song Feijing incredulously, slowly fell, and tumbled down the steps.

chapters.title: Regicide
chapters.content:
The empress saw her father being killed and rushed out of the palace in shock. She held her father, staring at Song Feijing in disbelief.

Xiangjun watched the scene, her hands trembling uncontrollably. Xue Jiaojiao took her hand and soothed her, saying, "Don't be afraid, sister. We're safe now. With me here, nothing will happen to you."

Xiangjun nodded, pretending to be terrified.

But only she knew that her trembling was not from fear, but from excitement.

The empress and Prime Minister Yang had lost. They had lost because they thought they could control the situation with the empress's palace authority. They had been in high positions for too long and had forgotten that power does not flow only from the top down.

They had not expected Song Feijing to overturn the table, ensuring that no one could sit at it.

Away from the table, it was whoever held the knife who had the final say.

Seeing Yang Jing Shan, who was already thoroughly dead, Xiangjun felt both absurd and enlightened.

So, the powerful prime minister who had controlled the civil official group for many years could not withstand a single blade. It was truly amusing.

...

The empress, tears in her eyes, glared at Song Feijing. "Song Feijing, what about the historical records and your reputation?"

Song Feijing sneered, "That is why I won't kill Her Majesty the Empress. After I assist the new emperor to the throne, I will deal with you, this traitorous woman, on behalf of the late emperor. Then, the world will know the crimes of Her Majesty the Empress and the Yang family."

Song Feijing kicked the empress aside and then walked towards the hall with his sword.

"Feijing!" The noble consort rushed up to block Song Feijing. "What are you going to do?"

"Jiaojiao, step aside. After today, the Fourth Prince, your Yuanze, will be able to inherit the throne."

The noble consort shook her head. "Why did you bring soldiers? Was it you? Were you the one who poisoned the emperor?"

While the noble consort and Song Feijing were arguing, Xiao Luzi had already sneaked to Xiangjun's side and was pulling her away.

Xiangjun whispered, "Did you see Physician Liu?"

Xiao Luzi nodded. In the chaos just now, he had already spoken to Physician Liu.

Xiao Luzi held Xiangjun's hand and lightly traced on it. Xiangjun finally felt at ease.

Looking back at the noble consort and Song Feijing, they were still arguing.

Suddenly, the noble consort rushed to the guard behind Song Feijing, drew the guard's sword, and held it to her own neck.

"Give me the antidote. If the emperor dies from the poison, I will die with him!"

Song Feijing was shocked. "Jiaojiao! I did all this for you! Why are you forcing me? You knew about the emperor's poisoning."

The noble consort said sadly and angrily, "I asked you to kill Consort Qin Yue, not to harm the emperor!"

"What good would killing that Consort Yue do? Yuanze's face is already disfigured. He can't be the crown prince anymore. This is our only chance!"

"I would rather Yuanze be an idle prince than have him become emperor by stepping on his father's life!"

But Song Feijing was not willing to give up just like that. He gave a signal to his men, and two people came forward, snatched the sword from the noble consort's hand, and restrained her before she could react.

Song Feijing: "It doesn't matter. You can hate me. After I enthrone Yuanze as emperor and become the regent, we will have a lifetime together."

Noble Consort: "If you dare to harm the emperor, I will not live alone!"

Song Feijing stepped into the main hall, but as soon as one foot stepped in, it was immediately kicked out, and he heavily fell to the ground.

Then, a person walked out from the room, holding an embroidered spring knife, with blood all over his kirin robe. It was Gu Tingxue.

Immediately after, the doors opened, and behind Zhou Zidou stood Gu Tingxue's Shence Army. The Shence Army rushed in and quickly annihilated all of Song Feijing's men.

Zhou Zidou also beheaded the imperial army commander. Song Feijing was captured.

Gu Tingxue then turned to report to the room, "Your Majesty, the rebel army has been annihilated, and the traitor Song Feijing has been captured."

"Good!"

Finally, the emperor, supported by someone, walked out of the hall. Although he still looked a bit ill, his spirit seemed fine.

"Impossible!" Song Feijing looked at the emperor unwillingly. "That poison has no antidote."

The emperor sneered, "I was never poisoned. If I didn't pretend to be poisoned, how could I have uprooted all your wings?"

The emperor glanced at the noble consort, who was sitting on the ground with tears all over her face, and sighed, helping her up.

In a life-and-death moment, only his Jiaojiao cared about his life. The empress only cared about power.

"Tingxue, send someone to take the empresses and the princes and princesses back."

Xiangjun knew that the following matters would involve royal secrets. Although she really wanted to continue watching the excitement, she had to be sent back to her palace by the palace servants.

On the way back, the palace gate was tightly closed. Only after Xiangjun called out a few times did she hear Meng Mei's cautious voice from inside, "Your Majesty?"

"It's me. It's fine. Open the door."

Meng Mei then opened the palace gate and said in a flustered manner, "Your Majesty, you're finally back. Two groups of people came knocking on the door, very aggressively, as if they were going to kill someone. They scared us to death."

"Let's talk inside."

The palace gate was closed again. Xiangjun first went to check on Yuan Ji. Seeing that the child was fine, she finally breathed a sigh of relief. She pulled Qing Lian and told her everything that happened today.

"From now on, we shouldn't go anywhere. There will be more trouble."

The palace gate was closed for three days. In the imperial residence, no one knew how many people had died. All those involved in Song Feijing's rebellion were rooted out. Song Feijing's entire force in the harem was uprooted.

Prime Minister Yang was dead, and the empress's forces were also heavily damaged. For a time, the imperial residence was filled with panic.

Xiangjun received news again when Physician Liu came to check her pulse.

"Thank you, Your Majesty, for your guidance. The director of the Imperial Hospital colluded with the traitor Song Feijing and has been imprisoned. Now, His Majesty has entrusted the affairs of the Imperial Hospital entirely to me."

"Then I should congratulate Physician Liu on his promotion."

Meng Mei stood beside her, not knowing what to do. How did her brother get promoted?

Xiangjun then told Meng Mei about her plan with Physician Liu.

It turned out that this time, the emperor pretended to be poisoned. Because Physician Liu, with his "excellent medical skills," discovered the emperor's poisoning and secretly warned the emperor. The emperor then followed the trail to uncover Prime Minister Song's plot.

The emperor deliberately set a trap, hoping to take this opportunity to weaken the Yang and Song families.

Now, many officials of the Yang family had been killed by Song Feijing, and Song Feijing's rebellion could be used as a legitimate reason to deal with him and the Jiangnan faction. The emperor was naturally overjoyed.

As a meritorious official, Physician Liu naturally rose step by step.

"What happened to Prime Minister Song?" Xiangjun asked curiously.

"Song Feijing failed in his regicide attempt and has confessed all his plans. His Majesty is now detaining him in the imperial residence. However, the matter of the front court and the harem colluding is not suitable to be publicized, so... His Majesty has ordered Noble Consort to handle it."

"What does that mean?"

"His Majesty has ordered Noble Consort to personally end Song Feijing."

Xiangjun fell silent. She had still underestimated the emperor's ruthlessness. The noble consort had already threatened to die to save him, proving her feelings for the emperor. But the emperor still wanted to break her heart.

It seemed that being loved by this emperor and being placed in his heart was not a good thing...

That night, a woman's piercing scream echoed throughout the imperial residence. The scream was so piercing that Xiangjun, who was a light sleeper, was awakened.

She sat for a while and heard no more. Just as she was about to call Xiao Luzi in to ask what happened, the window was pushed open.

It was Gu Tingxue.

---

chapters.title: I Won't Let You Die
chapters.content:
