Xiangjun felt it was time to make her move. When the Emperor came to see Yuanji and Yuanlang, she invited two of the new consorts to join them. Without leaving a trace, she reminded the Emperor—*the sisters in the harem miss you day and night.*

In truth, the Emperor was also helpless. The Empress clung to him tightly, and he couldn’t bear to see her sad. After all, he was a "man of deep affection." But when he saw the fresh, tender new consorts in Xiangjun’s palace, he was still tempted.

These new consorts had been trained by Xiangjun.

Sure enough, after just one night, they won the Emperor’s favor, and promotions followed one after another.

The Emperor found Xiangjun considerate and generous.

When the Empress Dowager heard of this, she also praised Xiangjun’s competence and rewarded her handsomely.

Though the Empress still took the Emperor for herself most of the time, everyone in the harem was still grateful to Consort Lian.

The consorts in the palace finally understood: the Empress was unreliable. Among them, whoever won Consort Lian’s favor would get to see the Emperor and rise in rank.

However, Xiangjun knew not to overdo it. She still had to uphold the Empress.

Thus, in a month, the Emperor spent ten days in the harem—seven with the Empress, one with Consort Lian, and the remaining two divided among the other consorts.

Before long, officials from the imperial court once again accused the Empress of jealousy.

Previously, when she was still a Noble Consort, she had been accused, and now, even as Empress, she faced the same charges.

The Empress was deeply distressed and even confided in Xiangjun that she regretted becoming Empress.

"As a concubine, it’s natural to compete for favor. But as Empress, I have a duty to fulfill—to push my own husband into the arms of others."

Xiangjun was speechless. What duties had she ever fulfilled?

The Empress didn’t know, but Xiangjun certainly did.

On the surface, the harem was still functioning normally, but due to the Empress’s poor management and inconsistent rewards and punishments, there was no shortage of chaos beneath the surface.

As the saying went, *kindness cannot command an army, nor can it govern a harem.*

Xiangjun saw it all but did not overstep the Empress to discipline those troublesome servants. Instead, she quietly cleaned up the mess, maintaining a superficial peace.

She was simply waiting for a major incident to occur, at which point she could rightfully take over the management of the harem from the Empress.

When the criticism from the imperial court grew fierce, the Empress had no choice but to act the part of a virtuous Empress. She pushed the Emperor toward other consorts, then wept sorrowfully, playing the zither alone in the night.

However, the Emperor, hearing the zither music from Ganlu Palace on his way, was stirred by memories.

Years ago, when he was still a prince, bullied by the palace servants, he had heard this very melody.

Separated by palace walls, this song had once reignited his hope for life.

Overcome with emotion, the Emperor abandoned the new consort and returned to Ganlu Palace to find the Empress.

The two shared a deep, passionate reunion, leaving the other consorts in the harem disgusted.

On one hand, the Empress pushed the Emperor toward others, yet on the other, she played the zither to lure him back—her words and actions were utterly inconsistent.

In comparison, Consort Lian was much better. When she competed for favor, she did so openly, even securing the Emperor’s exclusive visits to her palace.

When she helped others, she truly helped, directly elevating the ranks of several low-ranking consorts.

...

The harem was filled with complaints about the Empress, yet Xiangjun remained silent.

She had experienced the best of the Emperor’s affections—those self-indulgent, pleasure-seeking nights. She could do without them.

Besides, she had already obtained what she wanted recently. It was better to lie low for a while.

The Empress had delegated even more authority to her. In addition to the Department of Bedchamber Attendants, Xiangjun now controlled the Department of Imperial Cuisine.

These two departments were both crucial—after all, in the harem, what mattered most to the consorts were food and sleep?

The Empress was completely devoted to the Emperor, so in the entire palace, almost no one could rival Xiangjun.

Xiangjun basked in her success, enjoying the thrill of sitting in the second-highest position in the harem. She couldn’t even imagine how happy she would be when she became the most powerful woman in the harem.

No wonder men fought so hard for power.

Power was truly wonderful. Everyone sought her favor, each one more obedient than the last, as if they were her own children.

In high spirits, Xiangjun even found the flowers in the Imperial Garden more vibrant than usual. She lingered a little longer than usual.

Little Luzhi picked a peony and offered it to Xiangjun. Xiyu had just pinned it to her hair and was about to praise her mistress’s heavenly beauty when a voice came from behind the artificial hill...

"Lord Gu, thank you for arranging the imperial physician for me. Otherwise, I fear I would have died alone in Liangyi Hall. This is a sachet I made, filled with some sleep-aiding herbs. Please accept it, Lord Gu."

---

chapters.title: The Seductress
chapters.content:
Lord Gu?

Which Lord Gu?

The Lord Gu they knew?

Xiyu and Little Luzhi exchanged bewildered glances.

Xiangjun also paused mid-step, raising a hand to silence those behind her.

She quickly walked with Little Luzhi and Xiyu to the other side of the artificial hill, looking toward the speakers.

There, a palace concubine in full attire was blushing as she handed a deep indigo sachet to a man.

Recognizing the purple python robe and the slender yet powerful waist, Xiangjun realized the man receiving the gift was Gu Tingxue.

Little Luzhi and Xiyu were stunned, their eyes wide. They carefully observed Consort Lian’s expression, too frightened to even breathe.

This was bad. A disaster.

Xiangjun suppressed her anger. Originally, she had wanted to see Gu Tingxue’s reaction, but when his gaze fell on the sachet, she could no longer hold back.

She had no intention of testing him. She would cut this off immediately.

She had never planned to give Gu Tingxue the chance to accept the sachet.

Xiangjun shot a glare at Little Luzhi, who immediately shouted, "Who’s behind the hill?"

The two behind the hill were both startled.

The young concubine quickly withdrew her hand, looking flustered.

Xiangjun, supported by Little Luzhi’s arm, stepped forward, followed by a long procession of palace attendants.

The sight of the young concubine’s affected manner infuriated Xiangjun. She raised her voice, speaking in a sarcastic yet melodious tone: "I wondered who it was. So it’s Eunuch Tingxue. It’s been so long since I’ve seen you, Eunuch. Even at Taiji Hall, there’s no sign of you. I thought you were busy with the Emperor’s affairs, but who would have thought you’d be hiding here in the Imperial Garden, idle?"

Gu Tingxue, recognizing the familiar voice, slowly turned to face Xiangjun.

Today, she wore a pink satin dress embroidered with branching floral patterns, which made her already unparalleled beauty even more radiant and alluring, as dewy and dazzling as the peony in her hair.

After so long apart, the sight of her still left Gu Tingxue momentarily stunned.

But he quickly regained his composure, his expression unchanging. "This humble servant greets Consort Lian."

His cold tone wounded Xiangjun deeply.

Ah, so now that he had a new love interest, he no longer cared for his old flame.

She shot a glare at the young concubine, who was taken aback. She hadn’t expected the woman before her to be the renowned Consort Lian. She immediately panicked and greeted her.

"Concubine Bai of Liangyi Hall pays respects to Consort Lian. May Consort Lian enjoy boundless blessings."

Xiangjun examined Concubine Bai. She was fairly pretty, though not stunning, but she had an air of pure innocence and pitiful charm.

Hmph. Men loved that type.

Hadn’t Gu Tingxue said he despised pitiful, helpless women the most?

Sure enough, men’s words couldn’t be trusted.

Xiangjun stared at Concubine Bai without speaking. Without the mistress’s permission, Concubine Bai didn’t dare rise, kneeling halfway to the ground. Soon, she couldn’t maintain the position and began to wobble.

Xiangjun glanced at Gu Tingxue. Though he remained cold, his gaze was fixed solely on her, not once looking at Concubine Bai. This slightly improved her mood.

"Rise."

Only then did Concubine Bai, trembling, stand up, still clutching the sachet tightly.

Xiangjun glanced at Xiyu, who immediately walked over. Ignoring Concubine Bai’s panic, she snatched the sachet from her hands and presented it to Xiangjun.

"Your Highness, look..."

Xiangjun took the sachet and examined it, giving a cold laugh. "The embroidery is quite fine."

Concubine Bai stammered, "Th-Thank you for the praise, Consort Lian..."

"Since I’ve been having trouble sleeping lately, this sleep-aiding sachet would be perfect for me. I wonder, Concubine Bai, can you bear to part with it?"

"This humble concubine is honored that Consort Lian would take a liking to it."

How could Concubine Bai refuse? She lowered her head, her voice trembling as she replied, her entire body shaking slightly from fear.

Xiangjun handed the sachet back to Xiyu, who tucked it into her sleeve.

"Let me remind you, Concubine Bai—sachets are not something to be given away so casually. If others were to find out, it would be considered improper exchange. If someone were to make an issue of it, I could have you strangled with a white silk ribbon this very moment, and both the Emperor and Her Majesty the Empress would find my actions justified."

Hearing this, Concubine Bai immediately dropped to her knees, trembling all over.

"Please, Consort Lian, spare my life!"

Xiangjun glanced disdainfully at the kneeling Concubine Bai.

"Concubine Bai, it’s one thing to harm yourself, but don’t drag our imperial favorite down with you. If something were to happen to Lord Gu, who would help the Emperor with his burdens?"

Xiangjun shifted her gaze back to Gu Tingxue, smiling. "Lord Gu, don’t you agree?"

"Your Highness speaks the truth."

Concubine Bai was so intimidated by Xiangjun’s presence that she could barely speak.

"I... I have learned my lesson... Please, Consort Lian, spare my life."

Xiangjun covered her mouth with a handkerchief and laughed softly. "Look at you, so scared. I was only joking. How could I possibly have you strangled? Xiyu, help Concubine Bai up."

Xiyu immediately stepped forward and yanked Concubine Bai to her feet, showing no gentleness at all.

Concubine Bai staggered before steadying herself. She didn’t dare say more, keeping her head down, her face filled with terror.

Xiangjun turned back to Gu Tingxue with a smile. "Lord Tingxue, you have no objections to me disciplining a harem concubine, do you?"

"This humble servant would not dare. As the one who assists in managing the six palaces, it is Your Highness’s duty to reprimand the concubines."

Seeing that Gu Tingxue’s expression remained unchanged and he truly had no intention of speaking up for Concubine Bai, Xiangjun’s anger subsided slightly.

"Hmph. Let’s go."

Xiangjun adjusted the peony in her hair, shot Gu Tingxue one last glance, then left with her entourage in a grand procession.

After they had left, Concubine Bai finally approached Gu Tingxue, her movements unsteady.

"Lord Gu, did I... did I cause trouble for you? I’m sorry... I didn’t know... Will Consort Lian say something to the Emperor?"

Concubine Bai’s eyes were red-rimmed, as if she might cry at any moment.

"Don’t worry too much. Consort Lian is the kindest person in this harem. She won’t do anything to you. However, giving sachets like this is indeed inappropriate. Concubine Bai, do not do it again."

"But I only wanted to thank you!"

"There’s no need for you to thank me, Concubine Bai. Your brother is under my command in the Divine Strategy Army. I arranged the physician for you because I promised him I would look after you. If anyone should thank me, it should be your brother. Now, return to your palace and do not accost me again. Farewell."

Gu Tingxue turned and left.

In the Imperial Garden, dappled with sunlight and shadow, his tall, straight figure in the purple robe left a lingering impression in Concubine Bai’s eyes, filling her with a bittersweet sigh.

It took Concubine Bai a long while to snap out of it. With a mix of sorrow and sweetness, she left the Imperial Garden.

Naturally, this scene was reported back to Xiangjun.

Xiangjun wasn’t the type to simply walk away without keeping an eye on things. What if she left, and Concubine Bai continued to pester Gu Tingxue?

So, she had Little Luzhi eavesdrop.

Upon learning that after Gu Tingxue left, Concubine Bai had stood there for a long time, gazing at his retreating figure with a sweet, lovesick smile, Xiangjun couldn’t help but sneer.

She had some nerve—even bolder than Xiangjun herself. Xiangjun didn’t dare to openly gaze at Gu Tingxue with such affection in broad daylight.

"What a reckless creature. A true seductress. I must teach her a proper lesson."

chapters.title: What, Feeling Sorry for Her?
chapters.content:
The next day, Xiang Jun summoned Bai Cainü to her Chengxiang Hall.

Bai Cainü didn’t want to go and begged the mistress of the Er’yi Hall, Consort Wang Wanyi, for help.

But how could Wang Wanyi offend Lian Fei for Bai Cainü’s sake?

"Consort Lian oversees the Six Palaces and has the support of the Empress Dowager and the Empress. If she summons you, you must go. Even though you are my palace servant, I cannot override palace rules for you."

With no choice, Bai Cainü had to take a small palace maid and go to Chengxiang Hall with a trembling heart.

When Bai Cainü arrived, Xiang Jun was playing with the children along with Lady Jian Guifei.

At this moment, Yuan Ji was at his cutest— a tiny, sweet ball of a child, unsteady on his feet but insisting on walking, calling out "Lian Niangniang" with every step, melting Xiang Jun’s heart completely.

Lady Jian Guifei, on the other hand, was holding Yuan Lang, shaking a rattle for him.

Bai Cainü had not expected to see such a warm scene upon her arrival.

She carefully greeted the two consorts. Xiang Jun didn’t say much and directly ordered Meng Mei to bring the prepared brush, ink, paper, and inkstone to her.

"Now that you’re here, sit to the side and copy the palace rules. Copy them three times before you leave."

Lady Jian Guifei was somewhat surprised. This was the first time she had seen Xiang Jun reprimand a palace concubine.

Xiang Jun was known for being easygoing. Who could have offended her?

Lady Jian Guifei also felt a bit hostile toward Bai Cainü. She coldly glanced at her, said nothing more, and continued playing with the children alongside Xiang Jun.

The palace rules were over 800 pages long, with more than ten thousand characters. Even if she copied until nightfall, it would be impossible to finish three times.

But Bai Cainü didn’t dare to speak up. She could only lower her head and copy.

While Xiang Jun and Lady Jian Guifei were in harmony, Bai Cainü was in despair.

As she copied, tears began to fall from Bai Cainü’s eyes.

Seeing this, Xiang Jun had someone take Yuan Ji and Yuan Lang away.

With the two children gone, Lady Jian Guifei finally lost her temper. She slammed the table and coldly said, "Why are you crying? Her Majesty is teaching you by having you copy the palace rules. Are you crying because you’re dissatisfied? Are you being disrespectful to Consort Lian?"

Bai Cainü was so frightened that she knelt down with a thud, shaking her head. "I am not! This concubine would not dare to complain!"

"Sister, I think this Bai Cainü is so ungrateful. We should slap her mouth shut."

Upon hearing this, Bai Cainü cried even more sadly.

Xiang Jun shot a fierce glance at her.

"If you cry again, I will immediately have someone slap your mouth shut."

Bai Cainü immediately stopped her tears, kneeling on the ground, her shoulders trembling slightly.

"Continue copying."

Xiang Jun stood up, ordered Meng Mei to keep an eye on Bai Cainü, and then left with Lady Jian Guifei.

They took the two children to Qian Li Pool to feed the fish. Only then did Lady Jian Guifei ask, "How did that Bai Cainü offend you, Your Highness?"

"It’s not that she offended me, but she is really restless. I caught her in the Imperial Garden trying to give an embroidered pouch she made to Eunuch Ting Xue. Although Eunuch Ting Xue refused, he is a servant close to His Majesty. If someone with ill intentions were to make something of this, would she still have her life?"

Lady Jian Guifei’s expression changed drastically. "She really doesn’t know what’s good for her. How can a palace concubine give her own embroidery to a eunuch? She truly has no regard for her life. And she still dares to cry today? Your Highness should really make her kneel in Chengxiang Hall for a few hours and have all her palace servants beaten with a board."

Xiang Jun coldly humphed.

"Isn’t that right? I am just too kind."

"However, this Eunuch Ting Xue is indeed very likable." Lady Jian Guifei casually sighed.

Xiang Jun was feeding the fish, her face calm, but Lady Jian Guifei’s words had piqued her interest.

"Oh? Why does my sister say that? Have you heard something?"

"I’ve heard, and I’ve even seen small palace maids giving him sachets several times. There are quite a few palace maids in the palace who want to be paired with Eunuch Ting Xue. The other day at the Tai Ji Hall, I even heard His Majesty joke that he would grant Eunuch Ting Xue a marriage, bestowing him with a few beautiful palace maids."

Xiang Jun’s hand trembled, and the entire plate of fish food fell, dropping into the pool.

"Oh my, Your Highness, are you trying to overfeed the fish?"

The small eunuch beside her, Xiao Luzi, quickly handed Xiang Jun more fish food.

Xiang Jun awkwardly smiled, pretending to be casual as she asked, "Did Eunuch Ting Xue accept the palace maids His Majesty bestowed upon him?"

"He did not. After Eunuch Ting Xue left, I heard His Majesty sigh that Ting Xue truly does not go near women and has no other hobbies. He doesn’t even know what to bestow upon Minister Gu."

Xiang Jun finally let out a slight breath, but she had lost the mood to feed the fish and soon returned with her people...

Since Bai Cainü had not finished copying the palace rules on the first day, she had to come to Chengxiang Hall to copy them for the next two days.

Xiang Jun’s standards were high: the handwriting had to be neat, and if there was a single character copied wrong, the entire page had to be rewritten.

Bai Cainü didn’t dare to cry openly, so she could only copy the palace rules while secretly wiping her tears.

Xiang Jun couldn’t help but roll her eyes, but she wouldn’t soften her heart because of a woman’s tears.

These tears came and went as she pleased.

But what Xiang Jun never expected was that Bai Cainü would actually bring Gu Tingxue here.

Xiao Luzi whispered in Xiang Jun’s ear, "Your Highness, Eunuch Ting Xue is outside. He says His Majesty sent him to deliver a message to you."

Upon hearing that Eunuch Ting Xue was outside, Bai Cainü immediately lifted her head, turning to look outside with joyful surprise.

Xiang Jun glared at her.

"What are you looking at? Keep copying."

Bai Cainü had no choice but to hurriedly lower her head and continue copying. Only then did Xiang Jun darken her face and say, "Invite him in."

Gu Tingxue entered, bowing to Xiang Jun, who was reclining on the noble consort’s couch.

Today, Gu Tingxue was wearing the red python robe of an inner court official, which made his skin look as white as snow.

Especially his lips—red and moist, they looked very kissable.

Xiang Jun just stared at Gu Tingxue expressionlessly, not saying a word.

Bai Cainü carefully lifted her head and saw Lian Fei staring at Gu Tingxue like this. She panicked, afraid that Lian Fei would make things difficult for Gu Tingxue.

She looked at Gu Tingxue worriedly, fearing that he might offend Consort Lian because of her.

Xiang Jun noticed that, apart from herself, someone else was staring at Gu Tingxue.

Her sharp gaze swept over and landed on Bai Cainü’s face.

"Bai Cainü, do you have time to look around? It seems three copies of the palace rules are still too few. You can copy one more."

Bai Cainü didn’t dare to speak, so she quickly pursed her lips, lowered her head, and continued copying.

Only then did Xiang Jun look back at Gu Tingxue. She lightly pressed one finger to her temple, tilted her head, and smiled as she asked, "What wind brings Eunuch Ting Xue to my Chengxiang Hall? You are truly a rare guest..."

"I have come on His Majesty’s behalf to invite Your Highness to Ren Shou Palace."

"Did he say what it was about?"

"Your Highness will know when you arrive."

Xiang Jun felt that Gu Tingxue had come specifically to help Bai Cainü out of her predicament!

Xiang Jun leaned on the soft couch, put down the book she had been reading halfway, and glanced at Bai Cainü again.

Bai Cainü felt Xiang Jun’s gaze and shivered.

"Your Highness should hurry to Ren Shou Palace. Don’t keep His Majesty and the Empress Dowager waiting."

Xiang Jun, suppressing her anger, still stood up.

"Bai Cainü will stay in my Chengxiang Hall and continue copying the palace rules. I hope that by the time I return, you will have finished."

The sedan chair was already waiting outside.

As Xiang Jun walked out of Chengxiang Hall and was about to take Xiao Luzi’s hand to board the sedan chair, a familiar hand reached out.

Xiang Jun hesitated for a moment but still placed her hand on Gu Tingxue’s.

Just as her mood improved slightly, she heard Gu Tingxue lower his voice and say, "Why are you making things difficult for her?"

This sentence completely infuriated Xiang Jun.

Xiang Jun glared at Gu Tingxue and whispered, "What, does Eunuch Ting Xue feel sorry for her?"

---

chapters.title: This Palace Does Not Deign to Make Things Difficult for Palace Concubines
chapters.content:
"I am only helping her for the sake of her brother. Please, Your Highness, do not make things difficult for her."

Xiang Jun coldly laughed.

"Eunuch Ting Xue misunderstands. This palace is not making things difficult for her; I am helping her. In the Imperial Garden, she gave an embroidered pouch she made to one of His Majesty’s servants. Does she not value her life? Do you not value yours either?"

"I did not intend to accept it."

Xiang Jun’s face was full of righteous indignation. "Whether you accept it or not, the fact that she offered it and was seen doing so is already your fault. Do you not understand that?"

Seeing that Gu Tingxue had nothing to say in his defense, Xiang Jun continued to lecture him.

"If this palace does not teach Bai Cainü a lesson, she will only become more arrogant and reckless. Who knows what other foolish things she might do in the future? This palace is only punishing her by making her copy a few words. What kind of punishment is that? When this palace was an attendant, I was often punished to kneel for two hours at a time. Did I cry? Humph, the way she acts so delicately makes me annoyed. If she can’t even endure this little hardship, she should leave the palace as soon as possible, lest she die and no one claims her body."

Gu Tingxue looked at Xiang Jun, who was speaking so harshly, and suppressed the smile at the corner of his mouth. On the surface, however, he still maintained his usual indifferent, lifeless expression.

"Your Highness is right. If that is the case, then punish her as you see fit."

Xiang Jun glanced at the corner of Gu Tingxue’s mouth, which he hadn’t managed to suppress, and coldly humphed. "Eunuch Ting Xue came specifically to save someone, and now you’re giving up?"

"Who said I came to save anyone?"

"Then what is it?"

"Your Highness misunderstands. I am not that kind. I did not send anyone to watch Bai Cainü, so how would I know she was here? I just happened to run into her, that’s all."

"Is that so? This palace does not believe it." Xiang Jun said sarcastically, "Since when does delivering a simple message require Eunuch Ting Xue to do it?"

Indeed, such a task was not something Gu Tingxue should be doing.

But he really couldn’t hold back anymore.

He had been enduring not to come see Xiang Jun, but a few days ago, he had accidentally run into her in the Imperial Garden and couldn’t resist anymore. That was why he had taken this errand from the Empress Dowager.

"Hopefully it is as you say."

Xiang Jun fiercely pinched Gu Tingxue’s arm, but his arm was too hard, and she couldn’t even make a dent. Frustrated, she stomped on Gu Tingxue’s boot. Hearing him grunt, Xiang Jun was finally satisfied and boarded the sedan chair.

...

When she arrived at the Emperor’s place, Xiang Jun found out that today really wasn’t about Gu Tingxue intentionally coming to save someone. His Majesty truly had business with her.

It turned out that the Imperial Astronomer’s Office had set the wedding date for her brother, Xu Huanwen, and Miss Li. It was to be in two months.

As a concubine, Xiang Jun was not supposed to leave the palace to attend the ceremony. However, the Empress Dowager had requested a favor from His Majesty, and the Emperor agreed to allow her to leave the palace for two hours, escorted by Gu Tingxue, to attend her brother’s wedding.

"Are you happy?"

Xiang Jun immediately expressed her gratitude to the Emperor and the Empress Dowager for their favor. Taking advantage of the Empress Dowager’s presence, she also asked His Majesty for many rewards for her brother.

The Emperor helplessly joked that Xiang Jun was like a debt collector, but with a wave of his hand, he still ordered Gu Tingxue to prepare a generous gift for Xu Huanwen.

After returning to Chengxiang Hall, Bai Cainü was still copying the palace rules with a grievance.

Xiang Jun was in a good mood today and didn’t feel like watching someone cry, so she allowed Bai Cainü to return to her palace to continue copying. She would send someone to collect the work tomorrow.

After Bai Cainü left, Xiao Luzi immediately said to Xiang Jun, "Your Highness, this servant has looked into it. That Bai Cainü’s brother is named Bai Fan. He is merely a low-ranking officer in the Shence Army. Previously, he was just a minor official in a government office in Shaanxi. A few years ago, there was a famine and a peasant uprising in Shaanxi. Minister Gu saved his life, which was how he got the opportunity to join the Shence Army. Their entire family is dead, and it’s just the two siblings relying on each other. This kind of ignorant little attendant, with no background, Your Highness has the authority to oversee the Six Palaces. With one word, you could make her life a living hell. Should this servant go and inform her?"

Xiang Jun darkened her face and said, "No need. This palace only wants her to be more careful in her actions, so she doesn’t harm Ting Xue. This palace does not deign to make things difficult for palace concubines."

"Yes, this servant understands."

After thinking for a moment, Xiang Jun added, "The mistress of Er’yi Hall is Wang Wanyi, right?"

"Yes," Xiao Luzi replied.

Wang Wanyi was the mother of the Grand Princess. Xiang Jun didn’t want to make things difficult for her, but giving her a warning was acceptable.

"You have someone keep an eye on Er’yi Hall. Bai Cainü is His Majesty’s woman. No matter what, we cannot let the palace servants bully her. It’s said that when she was ill, she couldn’t even call for an imperial physician. If word gets out, it will reflect poorly on this palace."

Xi Ru, who was standing nearby, said discontentedly, "Your Highness, why are you still helping her?"

Xiang Jun coldly humphed, picked up the *Book of the Later Han*, and continued reading. She slowly said, "Since she is the younger sister of Ting Xue’s subordinate, this palace will help keep an eye on her."

Otherwise, she might cause trouble for Gu Tingxue again. This girl’s mind seemed to be missing a screw, and she was far too bold.

If Bai Cainü dirtied Xiang Jun’s knife, she could still clean it.

But if she ruined him, then she would truly be wronged to death.

Xiao Luzi was about to leave when Xiang Jun called him back.

"Wait."

"Your Highness, do you have any other orders?"

"You go and investigate for this palace how many women in the palace have an improper relationship with our Eunuch Ting Xue."

In her past life, Xiang Jun and Gu Tingxue had never even met, yet he had still secretly given her medicine to save her life. This showed that Gu Tingxue was a sentimental man. Who knew how many "good sisters" he had saved?

The next day, several palace servants from Er’yi Hall were beaten with a board.

These were all Wang Wanyi’s palace servants. Wang Wanyi stood to the side with a darkened face but didn’t dare say a word.

"Eunuch Liu, why is this happening?"

Xiao Luzi’s real name was Liu Lu. Now he was already a eunuch in charge of affairs. He held his head high, wearing a faint smile, and said in a sarcastic tone, "Our Consort Lian oversees the Six Palaces. She discovered that these palace maids were abusing their power, even preventing Bai Cainü of Er’yi Hall from seeing the imperial physician. Usually, they also deliberately humiliated Bai Cainü and her palace maid, reduced the charcoal in Bai Cainü’s room, and put strange things in her food... I suppose Wang Wanyi was unaware of these matters?"

Wang Wanyi’s expression worsened, and she said embarrassedly, "I truly did not know."

"Since Wanyi Consort was unaware, then these servants have the additional crime of deceiving their mistress," Xiao Luzi said, looking at the palace servants being beaten. He raised his voice and said, "Each of them will receive ten additional strikes."

One after another, the cries of pain echoed. Xiao Luzi still wore a smile, but Wang Wanyi was so angry that smoke could practically be seen coming out of her nostrils.

Xiao Luzi continued with a smile, "Our mistress said that the concubines in the harem should live in harmony. I hope Wang Wanyi manages her Er’yi Hall properly. If she cannot, then our Consort Lian will have to help her manage it."

Although Wang Wanyi was angry, she knew that a higher rank could crush her. She had to endure her displeasure and say, "I understand. Please trouble Eunuch Liu to pass a message to Consort Lian for me. I thank Consort Lian for her guidance and will keep it in mind."

Wang Wanyi turned and entered her palace, ordering someone to close the door. She paid no more attention to the pitiful cries of her close palace maids outside.

Bai Cainü and her small palace maid, who were standing nearby, were so scared that they were dumbfounded. The several palace maids who had bullied her were already beaten to a bloody pulp.

Only then did Xiao Luzi walk over to Bai Cainü and respectfully say, "Bai Cainü, have you finished copying the palace rules that Her Highness ordered you to copy? This servant has come to collect them today."

---

chapters.title: Our Mistress Cares Deeply for You, Eunuch
chapters.content:
"White Cainü, you may leave. Remember, this palace does not deign to make things difficult for palace concubines. However, if you dare to cause trouble for Eunuch Ting Xue again, do not blame this palace for being ruthless."

Bai Cainü quickly kowtowed and left with her small palace maid.

After they left, Xi Ru couldn’t help but say, "Your Highness, you are really too kind to her. She clearly came to cause trouble for you."

Xiang Jun coldly humphed and said, "She is the younger sister of Eunuch Ting Xue’s subordinate. If she causes trouble, it will implicate him. This palace is not doing it for her, but for him."

Xi Ru blinked and said, "Your Highness, you care so much about Eunuch Ting Xue?"

Xiang Jun’s face turned slightly red. She picked up a teacup and took a sip to cover her embarrassment. "This palace is the one who oversees the Six Palaces. If something happens to the palace servants, it will reflect poorly on this palace."

Xi Ru smiled and said, "Your Highness, you don’t have to explain. We all know that you care about Eunuch Ting Xue."

Xiang Jun glared at her and said, "You little girl, what do you know? Get out."

Xi Ru stuck out her tongue and left with a smile.

Xiang Jun leaned back on the soft couch, her mind filled with thoughts of Gu Tingxue.

She had to admit that she was indeed concerned about him.

But she couldn’t let others know, especially Gu Tingxue himself.

Otherwise, he would become even more arrogant.

Xiang Jun sighed and picked up the book again, trying to distract herself.

But her mind kept wandering back to Gu Tingxue.

She remembered the way he had looked at her, the way he had spoken to her, and the way he had defended Bai Cainü.

Xiang Jun’s heart was in turmoil.

She didn’t know what to do with Gu Tingxue.

But one thing was for sure: she couldn’t let him go.

She couldn’t let him be with anyone else.

Xiang Jun clenched her fists, her eyes filled with determination.

She would not let Gu Tingxue slip away.

She would not let anyone else have him.

Xiang Jun took a deep breath and calmed herself down.

She had to be patient.

She had to be smart.

She would wait for the right moment to strike.

And when that moment came, she would make Gu Tingxue hers forever.

chapters.title: Consort Lian is So Generous
chapters.content:
White Caifu froze—had they come to retrieve the palace rules?

Seeing her expression, Xiao Luzi smiled. "Cough, punishing those palace maids was just a passing matter. Retrieving the palace rules is the important thing."

White Caifu’s face turned pale as she nodded. "I’ve finished copying them. I’ll go fetch them now."

She and the little palace maid behind her returned to her quarters to retrieve the palace rules she had spent all night copying.

By the time they returned, the punishment of those palace maids was already over. The women had been dragged away, leaving a trail of blood on the ground.

The terror on White Caifu’s face deepened. She suddenly realized that Consort Lian ordering her to copy the palace rules couldn’t even be considered a punishment.

Xiao Luzi took the palace rules and glanced at the people behind him. Several little eunuchs stepped forward, carrying two trays and two baskets of fine charcoal.

"Consort Lian says that White Caifu has been wronged before, and it was her oversight. You may use this charcoal first. From now on, the Palace Administration will deliver your supplies on time and in full. If any servants dare to take your things again, White Caifu, just send someone to inform me. I will certainly help you deal with them."

White Caifu quickly had someone put the items away.

Then, stammering, she pulled out a rather flat money pouch from her sleeve and handed it to Xiao Luzi with trembling hands.

"Please accept this, Eunuch Liu."

Before entering the palace, her brother had told her not to offend the palace servants and not to be stingy with rewards.

But White Caifu had been poor for so long as a child. Even though her brother had earned some silver working under Minister Gu in recent years, she truly couldn’t bear to part with the money he had risked his life for.

That was why she had been reluctant to give rewards before, which led to the servants of the Two Instruments Hall looking down on her and bullying her openly and secretly.

She had no choice but to seek help from Gu Tingxue.

Now, even if she still hated to part with it, she had learned her lesson.

Xiao Luzi took a look and pushed it back.

"White Caifu, keep it to reward other servants."

White Caifu hesitated for a moment before taking it back into her sleeve.

Xiao Luzi’s expression stiffened for a rare moment. This White Caifu really wasn’t very bright. Even though he hadn’t intended to take her money, she could at least pretend to refuse politely a few more times, couldn’t she?

"Then this servant will take his leave."

"Eunuch Liu..." White Caifu gathered her courage to call out to Xiao Luzi. "Why did Consort Lian help me? I thought Consort Lian didn’t like me..."

"Consort Lian is the fairest. She had you copy the palace rules because you made a mistake. She had the palace maids of the Two Instruments Hall beaten because they made a mistake. It’s not about taking sides. White Caifu, you really shouldn’t say such things."

White Caifu nodded in a daze.

Xiao Luzi was about to leave again when White Caifu called out to him once more.

Xiao Luzi stumbled slightly. Couldn’t this White Caifu just say everything at once?

"What else does White Caifu have to instruct?"

"I... I want to tell Consort Lian that when I gave the sachet to Minister Gu, I really didn’t understand. I had wanted to buy a nice gift to thank him, but the sachets were too expensive, so I thought embroidering one myself would be cheaper. The medicinal herbs were also picked by me in the Imperial Garden... Now that I’ve copied the palace rules four times, I truly understand where I went wrong. I hope Consort Lian can forgive me."

Xiao Luzi had never expected that White Caifu would have the audacity to give her own embroidery to an inner court official just to save money!

"Her Highness is magnanimous. She won’t hold a grudge. This servant really must return to Chengxiang Hall to report back."

Xiao Luzi nodded to White Caifu, then turned and led the little eunuchs behind him, marching away with his head held high.

After they left, White Caifu remained standing there, lost in thought.

The little palace maid reminded her, "Caifu, let’s go back quickly. If Wang Wanyi sees you wandering around, she’ll be angry again."

White Caifu hurriedly returned to her quarters with the little palace maid.

After closing the door, she finally opened Consort Lian’s gift to inspect it. To her surprise, she found that Consort Lian had actually given her two boxes of loose silver.

At the sight of the silver, White Caifu collapsed onto the box, sobbing uncontrollably.

The little palace maid was used to seeing White Caifu cry. In the few months since entering the palace, White Caifu had cried at least a hundred times. But today, she was crying especially hard—even when she had been on the verge of death, she hadn’t cried like this.

"Caifu, what’s wrong with you?"

"Consort Lian is actually cold on the outside but warm on the inside. I misunderstood her. Consort Lian is so generous..."

...

When Xiangjun heard Xiao Luzi’s report, her face twitched involuntarily.

This was the first time she had ever encountered such a stingy consort.

She had originally thought that for a low-ranking consort, nothing would be more useful than silver. She hadn’t expected that she would actually send the right thing.

"Forget it. All of you, keep a closer eye on the other palaces. This batch of new palace entrants all come from humble backgrounds. I fear White Caifu’s situation is not an exception. Let the Six Palaces be on guard. I cannot stand the sight of the strong bullying the weak."

News of Wang Wanyi’s palace maids being punished quickly spread throughout the palace.

Everyone realized that their gentle and amiable Consort Lian also had a thunderous side. They all became more restrained, at least not daring to openly mistreat low-ranking consorts.

Xiangjun was very satisfied. If everyone behaved honestly, her life would be easier.

Two days later, Xiao Luzi reported to Xiangjun what he had found out about Gu Tingxue.

He hadn’t known before, but now he realized—Gu Tingxue was really good at attracting people.

In the palace, countless pretty little palace maids wanted to be his partner, and from time to time, some even climbed into his bed.

That was bad enough, but outside the palace, it was even worse. Many officials, in order to flatter Gu Tingxue, sent him beautiful women. Even if Gu Tingxue refused, people kept sending them.

As Xiangjun listened to Xiao Luzi’s vivid description, her expression grew darker and darker.

This couldn’t go on.

Xiangjun didn’t believe in the nonsense of love lasting forever. Any kind of relationship required effort to maintain.

Fortunately, Gu Tingxue had been helping her with matters recently, which proved he had already softened. She might as well take advantage of the fact that the Emperor currently only had eyes for the Empress and first secure Gu Tingxue’s heart.

Xiangjun said to Xiao Luzi, "Go and bring Tingxue to me."

"Ah? Me?"

Xiao Luzi’s face was full of "Are you sure it’s me?" expression.

"How could I possibly summon Eunuch Gu? What am I compared to Eunuch Gu? Your Highness, are you sure you don’t want me to pass a message to Minister Gu?"

"I don’t care. Bring him to me. Tonight, I’ll be waiting for him in Chengxiang Hall."

Xiao Luzi felt very uneasy. After much difficulty, he finally managed to see Gu Tingxue at the Office of Ceremonies.

But Gu Tingxue was very cold.

"What’s the matter? Just pass the message. Isn’t that how it’s always been?"

Unexpectedly, Xiao Luzi suddenly knelt down in front of Gu Tingxue.

Gu Tingxue frowned. "What are you doing kneeling for no reason? If your mistress finds out, she’ll think I’ve been giving you a hard time and get angry with me."

Xiao Luzi wiped at his non-existent tears and cried, "Minister Gu, please go see our mistress. If you don’t go see her soon, she’ll be so angry she might die!"

Gu Tingxue raised an eyebrow. "What’s she angry about?"

"Our mistress cares deeply for you, Minister Gu. When she saw you talking to that White Caifu, she was so angry she couldn’t sleep all night and even smashed things in her palace."

Gu Tingxue pressed his lips together, as if wanting to say something, but held back.

Xiao Luzi continued to add fuel to the fire.

"Our mistress these days can’t eat or sleep, fearing that you no longer care for her. Minister Gu, please go see our mistress. Otherwise, I’m truly worried she won’t be able to bear it."

Gu Tingxue was silent for a long moment. He knew Xiao Luzi was using a ploy, and he knew Xiangjun wouldn’t lose sleep over him. But he was still swayed.

"You go back first. I’ll go see Her Highness tonight."

Only then did Xiao Luzi’s tears turn to smiles. He quickly got up and was about to leave when Gu Tingxue called out to him.

"Minister Gu, do you have any other instructions?"

Gu Tingxue tossed Xiao Luzi a bulging money pouch. "A reward for you."

As he walked away, Xiao Luzi felt the weight of the pouch seemed a bit off.

He opened it and took a look—good heavens, it was full of gold melon seeds!

This errand had turned out quite well for him.

---

chapters.title: Tingxue, Are You on Bad Terms with Consort Lian?
chapters.content:
Xiao Luzi returned immediately to boast of his success to Xiangjun, even showing her the money pouch Gu Tingxue had rewarded him with.

Xiangjun took a look. "He’s quite generous. Keep it."

"Minister Gu is really kind, hehe." Xiao Luzi said with a grin.

Seeing Xiao Luzi so happy, Xiangjun looked displeased.

"Go to the treasury and take two gold ingots to play with. Don’t be so shallow. You are my servant—you should only think that I am the best."

Xiao Luzi happily kowtowed to Xiangjun. "Your Highness is naturally the best. This servant only has Your Highness in my heart."

Only then was Xiangjun satisfied, and she smiled happily.

Her people could only have her in their hearts.

Knowing that Gu Tingxue would come that night, Xiangjun bathed and changed clothes early, waiting for him.

She had thought it over—if she could just get him into bed, they would have made up. Some things didn’t need to be spelled out so clearly; that would be affected.

However, Xiangjun waited all night like this, even falling asleep, and Gu Tingxue never came.

It wasn’t until just before dawn that Xiangjun suddenly awoke. Seeing that the sky outside had already turned white, she realized Gu Tingxue wouldn’t be coming that night.

This time, Xiangjun was truly too angry to sleep. She smashed things all over the floor and threw a tantrum in Chengxiang Hall.

The next morning, Xiangjun, with a haggard face, ordered her palanquin to be prepared. She was going to Ganlu Palace.

"Your Highness, at this hour, the Empress has probably just gotten up. The Emperor is likely still there. What are you going to do?" Meng Mei asked curiously as she helped Xiangjun arrange her clothes.

"To complain!"

...

Xiangjun entered Ganlu Palace in tears, and before she even saw anyone, she started shouting, "Empress! You must take my side! You must help me! I’ve been bullied!"

Xiangjun entered the main hall and saw the Emperor and the Empress having breakfast together.

She put on an expression as if she hadn’t expected the Emperor to be there. Upon seeing the Emperor, she immediately stopped crying and stood to the side like a wronged little bride, properly greeting the Emperor and the Empress.

Seeing Xiangjun like this, the Emperor and the Empress exchanged a glance, both feeling a little helpless. They both looked at Xiangjun with the kind of expression one reserves for a child throwing a tantrum.

The Emperor pretended to be stern and said displeasedly, "How old are you? You’re already Consort Lian, who oversees the Six Palaces. How can you still come to the Empress to complain? Aren’t you ashamed?"

The Empress, however, gently pulled Xiangjun to sit beside her.

"What’s wrong? You look so haggard. Did you not sleep all night? Who bullied you? I’ll take your side."

Xiangjun glanced at the Emperor, looking as if she didn’t want to speak in front of him.

The Emperor found it amusing. "What? Am I not allowed to listen? Speak. Otherwise, I’ll have to punish you."

"I won’t speak to Your Majesty. You’re biased and definitely won’t take my side. I’ll only speak to Her Majesty the Empress."

The Emperor was even more curious now.

"Aren’t I biased enough toward you? In this entire harem, apart from the Empress, I dote on you the most. I think it’s because the Empress spoils you too much."

Empress Xue said gently, "Your Majesty, although Xiangjun is a bit spoiled, she doesn’t like to cause trouble. She must have truly been bullied. Let’s hear her out first."

Empress Xue patted Xiangjun’s hand and said softly, "What happened? Tell your sister."

Xiangjun glanced at the Emperor before whispering, "It’s that dog of a slave by Your Majesty’s side who bullied me!"

"Which dog of a slave? Tell me." The Emperor’s expression turned serious, his gaze sharp. "How dare one of my people bully you?"

Xiangjun’s eyes darted around before she whispered, "It’s that dog of a slave, Gu Tingxue."

The room fell silent for a moment, so quiet that one could hear breathing.

No one in the entire palace would call Gu Tingxue a "dog of a slave"—not even the Emperor.

Gu Tingxue was the Emperor’s most trusted and favored official. He had been granted the highest honors; when meeting the consorts of the harem, he was not required to address himself as a slave or kneel in greeting.

"Nonsense!" The Emperor looked at Xiangjun sternly and shouted, "How can you show such disrespect to Tingxue? He is my important minister."

Xiangjun’s eyes reddened as she tugged at the Empress’s sleeve. "Your Majesty the Empress, I told you, His Majesty wouldn’t take my side. He’s biased."

The Empress looked at the Emperor helplessly. Although the Empress was the mistress of the harem, she didn’t have the authority to deal with Gu Tingxue, as he could only be considered half a member of the harem.

Facing the Empress’s gaze, the Emperor’s expression softened slightly.

In truth, the Emperor wasn’t really angry with Xiangjun.

Although he had given Gu Tingxue face, in his heart, he still considered Gu Tingxue a slave. If his beloved consort called Gu Tingxue a slave, it wasn’t a big deal. However, the Empress Dowager would certainly be displeased if she found out.

Moreover, the consorts in the palace either feared Gu Tingxue or wanted to pull him to their side, so they naturally respected and fawned over him.

Xiangjun’s behavior, on the other hand, showed that she had no such intentions and was someone who didn’t like to scheme for power.

"Alright, speak. What did he do to you?"

Xiangjun wiped her tears.

"I was bumped into by a Caifu in the Imperial Garden, so I punished her. I didn’t expect that Caifu to be the younger sister of one of Minister Gu’s subordinates. Minister Gu wanted to intercede on her behalf, but how could I let a slave’s plea make me rescind the punishment? So I made her punishment heavier. Perhaps I offended Minister Gu by not giving him face, but he gave me a good scolding. His words were so harsh! It was fine before, but now that I’m overseeing the Six Palaces, I’m still being humiliated in public by a slave. How am I supposed to maintain my dignity in front of the other consorts? Your Majesty the Empress, you must make that dog of a..."

Xiangjun glanced at the Emperor and swallowed her words.

"Your Majesty the Empress, you are the mistress of the harem. You must make Gu Tingxue come to Chengxiang Hall in person and apologize to me!"

The Emperor listened with a headache. He hadn’t expected it to be such a trivial matter.

He knew Gu Tingxue well—he wasn’t the type to say harsh words. Perhaps it was Xiangjun calling him a "dog of a slave" that had angered him.

"Nonsense. The Empress can’t do anything about Gu Tingxue."

"Then will Your Majesty take my side?"

The Emperor thought for a moment before asking, "Which Caifu angered you?"

"White Caifu, from the Two Instruments Hall."

The Emperor remembered. That White Caifu’s elder brother was someone he intended to use—a man capable of leading troops in battle.

He had ordered Gu Tingxue to keep the man by his side for training, planning to send him to the northern border along with Zhou Zi in the future.

But the man had no family except for a younger sister, so the Emperor had taken his sister into the palace. After all, only by doing so could he trust the man completely.

However, he had been so preoccupied with the Empress lately that he had forgotten about White Caifu.

"How did she provoke you?"

"She cries too much. If I say a few words to her, she starts crying. It’s really annoying."

"Aren’t you the one who cries all the time?"

Xiangjun felt wronged and stopped speaking, only secretly tugging at the Empress’s sleeve.

The Emperor sighed. But Xiangjun was, after all, his beloved woman. If she scolded other consorts, they should endure it. This White Caifu was indeed tactless.

"Spoiled... So what punishment did you give her?"

"I just had her copy the palace rules. When I was punished by Consort Yue before, I had to kneel in the Imperial Garden."

The Emperor also felt that Xiangjun’s actions were not excessive. It was just a minor matter between women.

Gu Tingxue wasn’t the type to hold a grudge, so he must have been upset because Xiangjun called him a slave.

"Alright, it’s all minor. From now on, don’t call him a ‘dog of a slave’ and don’t provoke Tingxue. Since Tingxue made you lose face, this time, I’ll have him personally apologize to you. Stop bothering the Empress."

Only then did Xiangjun wipe her tears and nod.

The Empress looked at Xiangjun gently. "His Majesty has taken your side. Stop crying."

Xiangjun smiled sweetly. "Thank you, Your Majesty the Empress."

"His Majesty took your side, and you thank the Empress?"

Xiangjun blinked. "Thanking His Majesty and thanking Your Majesty the Empress are the same thing."

...

That day, after the morning court session, the Emperor summoned Gu Tingxue to the Taiji Hall.

The Emperor got straight to the point. "Tingxue, are you on bad terms with Consort Lian?"

chapters.title: It's All Your Fault, Noble Consort
chapters.content:
"Your Majesty, why do you say such a thing?"

"Consort Liang came to me to complain, saying you humiliated her. Is that true?"

After Xiangjun went to Ganlu Palace to lodge her complaint, Gu Tingxue had his informant, Li Fu, who was stationed near the Empress, notify him. So Gu Tingxue knew what Xiangjun had told the Emperor.

Gu Tingxue calmly replied, "Noble Consort Liang seems to dislike this humble servant. Whenever she speaks to me, her words are never pleasant."

The Emperor also felt that Xiangjun calling Gu Tingxue a "dog slave" had been excessive. If the Empress Dowager found out, she might even summon him for a scolding, saying he had spoiled his concubines.

"I have already reprimanded her. She is not allowed to spout nonsense in the future. But you did indeed humiliate her. Since she assists in managing the six palaces, I cannot let Noble Consort Liang lose face. So... when do you have time today? Go to Chengxiang Palace and apologize to Noble Consort Liang."

Gu Tingxue looked reluctant, as if he found it deeply humiliating.

The Emperor knew he was wronging Gu Tingxue, but he wanted Gu Tingxue to willingly accept this wrong for it to prove his loyalty. Over the past year or two, he had given Gu Tingxue more power. Although eunuchs could only rely on imperial authority, it was still necessary to occasionally discipline him.

This was the way to use people.

"What, unwilling?"

"This humble servant does not dare. It's just that the task Your Majesty assigned last night is not yet finished. After court, this humble servant must go to the imperial prison."

"Then go immediately after you finish."

"But that might be late into the night. Would it be better for this humble servant to go another day?"

"Go today." The Emperor's tone suddenly turned stern.

"Yes, this humble servant will finish the tasks assigned by Your Majesty and immediately go to Chengxiang Palace to apologize to Noble Consort Liang."

Only then did the Emperor nod in satisfaction, his tone softening slightly.

"Consort Liang does have a bit of a temper, but she is not malicious. If she punishes you, endure it. She won't make things too difficult for you. Don't take it to heart."

Gu Tingxue's voice was low as he said, "Yes, this humble servant accepts the punishment."

...

At night, Xiangjun had someone prepare a bath and change her clothes, then had tea brewed, and sat in the palace hall, waiting for Gu Tingxue to come and apologize.

He hadn't come when she complained yesterday, but today, he had no choice but to come.

Xiangjun did not wait long before Gu Tingxue arrived, looking travel-worn.

"Noble Consort, Eunuch Tingxue has arrived. He is standing outside the palace, saying he wants to plead guilty to you."

Xiangjun smiled triumphantly. "Let him in."

Since he had to go to the imperial prison that day, Gu Tingxue was wearing his purple official attire.

When Xiangjun saw Gu Tingxue enter in his purple robes, she narrowed her eyes slightly.

As soon as Gu Tingxue entered, he saw Xiangjun with her long, black, and silky hair cascading down, wearing a thin sleeping garment, lazily reclining on a soft couch, smiling at him.

Gu Tingxue quickly lowered his gaze, gave a slight nod, and said to Xiangjun, "This humble servant, Gu Tingxue, by the Emperor's command, has come to apologize to Noble Consort Liang."

"Apologize? How does Eunuch Tingxue plan to apologize to me?"

"Noble Consort is the master. This humble servant naturally leaves the punishment entirely to Noble Consort's discretion."

"Is that so?"

Xiangjun smiled, and with a wave of her hand, the small attendant beside her knocked over a candle stand.

"The candle stand in my palace is broken and cannot be placed. It will trouble Eunuch Tingxue to hold the candle for me all night."

After saying that, Xiangjun stood up and leisurely walked into the warm chamber of the bedchamber.

The small attendant handed the candle stand to Gu Tingxue.

"Lord Gu, please."

Gu Tingxue's face darkened, not knowing what game Xiangjun was playing.

"Lord Gu, please, don't make it difficult for us servants."

Gu Tingxue took the candle stand.

"Thank you, Lord Gu."

With a wave of her hand, the small attendant led the palace servants out in a crowd, leaving only Meng Mei and the small attendant outside to keep watch.

Gu Tingxue stood outside holding the candle stand for a while, then heard a voice from the warm chamber.

Xiangjun shouted sternly, "Dog slave, come in and hold the light for me!"

Gu Tingxue had no choice but to take the candle stand and walk into the warm chamber.

As soon as he passed the carved screen, a strange fragrance wafted over, and then Xiangjun pounced into his arms.

"Darling, you haven't come to see me for so long. Don't you miss me at all? How cruel..."

Gu Tingxue looked down at the woman in his arms, at her lips that he longed for day and night, at her feigned affection for him, and his gaze unconsciously deepened.

"When has Your Noble Consort ever thought of Tingxue?"

"So you deliberately let me see you pulling and tugging with that White Cai'er, wanting me to care about you and take the initiative to find you, isn't that right?"

Gu Tingxue frowned slightly. "This servant would not stoop to such things. There are always palace consorts pulling at me, asking me to do things. Noble Consort is always wandering around the palace. It was strange that we only met by chance that day."

Xiangjun narrowed her eyes.

So she had indeed misunderstood Gu Tingxue.

"Then I was jealous. Are you happy?"

"Noble Consort was not jealous."

"Oh? Then what was I angry about?"

Gu Tingxue helplessly smiled, reached out, and gently wrapped his arm around Xiangjun's waist.

"Noble Consort is domineering. You don't allow others to covet what belongs to you. Even if you don't care about someone, you won't let others think about them."

"Who said I don't care about Tingxue? I care about you deeply. You don't know how much I miss you."

"How much?"

"Day and night," Xiangjun said softly, standing on her toes and whispering in Gu Tingxue's ear, "Especially at night, I miss you the most."

Xiangjun's sweet words always came naturally, but even if they were insincere, Gu Tingxue could not resist.

Gu Tingxue unconsciously swallowed, and even his breathing became rapid.

Feeling Gu Tingxue's disordered breathing, Xiangjun's hand slid down Gu Tingxue's magnificent official robe to his jade belt at the waist, lightly hooking it.

"Has anyone ever told Tingxue that you look particularly handsome in this purple attire... I took a fancy to it at the Empress's coronation ceremony."

"What did Noble Consort take a fancy to?"

Xiangjun spread her hands, making a gesture as if measuring Gu Tingxue's waist. "I took a fancy to... Tingxue's slender waist..."

Gu Tingxue took a deep breath. He looked down at Xiangjun with that dark, lingering, and dangerous gaze that was unique to her.

Xiangjun was already accustomed to Gu Tingxue's sinister, predator-like gaze.

Perhaps this kind of gaze was Gu Tingxue's unique way of showing deep affection.

Xiangjun's soft hands hooked around Gu Tingxue's neck, and she stood on her toes to kiss his lips.

After a light peck, Xiangjun looked at Gu Tingxue reproachfully.

"Dog slave, come and accept your punishment."

The candle stand fell to the ground, and the candlelight instantly went out.

In the dim room, only a lamp by the bed was still lit.

...

"This is all Noble Consort's own doing."

chapters.title: Enemies in Public, Lovers in Private
chapters.content:
Early in the morning.

Seeing Gu Tingxue putting on his shoes and getting up, Xiangjun hugged him from behind.

"Leaving today, will Tingxue come again in the future?"

Gu Tingxue paused. "This servant would not dare not to come. Otherwise, Noble Consort will go to the Emperor to complain again."

Xiangjun smiled in triumph, tracing circles on Gu Tingxue's chest with her fingers.

"Am I not clever? Now the entire palace knows that my relationship with you is strained. Doesn't this enemies-in-public, lovers-in-private feeling make it especially exciting?"

Perhaps it was the word "lover" that moved Gu Tingxue.

He once again pressed Xiangjun into his arms and kissed her already swollen lips gently and cherishingly.

After a while, he reluctantly let go.

"What will we do about the bruises on Noble Consort's body?" Gu Tingxue asked.

Last night, they had both been venting some anger.

Neither of them mentioned their previous argument, tacitly pretending that nothing had happened.

Gu Tingxue's eyes flickered with a trace of guilt. "Does it hurt?"

"Is Tingxue asking if it hurt yesterday or if it hurts now?"

Gu Tingxue's expression darkened.

"Both."

Xiangjun wrapped her arms around Gu Tingxue's neck and pouted, "Yesterday, I forgot about the pain. Now it does hurt a bit, but if Tingxue comes to see me tonight and rubs some medicine on me, I won't feel the pain anymore."

Gu Tingxue sighed.

"I'll come again tonight. However, with so many bruises on your body, it will be hard to hide. People might suspect. Should I give an order and have Noble Consort rest in the palace due to illness?"

Xiangjun was somewhat pleased. This dog slave really needed to be taught a lesson, and now he even knew to ask about her.

"No need. Don't worry, I have my ways. I guarantee no one will suspect."

Xiangjun's smile was cunning. Gu Tingxue loved this smug little look of hers the most.

...

Early in the morning, in any palace with a bit of informants, the news from Chengxiang Palace had spread.

Noble Consort Liang and Gu Tingxue were on bad terms. She had gone to the Empress to complain, forcing the Emperor to intervene. The Emperor then ordered Gu Tingxue to apologize to Xiangjun.

Unexpectedly, Noble Consort Liang had actually punished Gu Tingxue, even making the esteemed Lord Gu spend an entire night as a human candlestick, kneeling on the ground and holding a candle for her all night.

If it were an ordinary eunuch, it might not be a big deal. Who in the palace hadn't seen small eunuchs or maids being mistreated?

But this was Gu Tingxue, the Emperor's watchdog overseeing the officials, the Lieutenant of the Shence Army, the Director of the Privy Council. Was he an ordinary eunuch?

In the palace, sometimes it was better to offend the master than to offend the key eunuchs who held power, let alone one as powerful as Gu Tingxue.

Had Noble Consort Liang always been this reckless?

She truly had lowly origins and lacked political acumen. She only knew how to vie for favor and had actually offended the one person she should never offend.

Inside Chengxiang Palace, after finishing breakfast, Xiyu came to report, whispering in Xiangjun's ear, "According to Noble Consort's instructions, the news has been spread. Now the entire palace knows that Noble Consort Liang has great prestige and has actually dealt with Eunuch Tingxue."

Xiangjun put down her rice bowl and wiped her mouth.

Xiyu's gaze fell on Xiangjun's exposed wrist, where there was a bruise.

"Is the sedan chair ready?"

"Replying to Noble Consort, it is already prepared."

"Let's go. Today is the 15th, the day when the entire palace pays respects to Her Majesty the Empress. We shouldn't keep everyone waiting."

...

In Ganlu Palace, Her Majesty the Empress sat on the throne. On the left front seat sat the mother of the Eldest Prince, Noble Consort De. The right seat was empty.

All the other consorts were present, except for Xiangjun.

Wang Wanyi cleared her throat and said in a neither friendly nor hostile tone, "Now Noble Consort Liang is quite formidable. Having reached the rank of consort, she no longer pretends and dares to offend anyone. A few days ago, she came to my palace to flaunt her power, and now she even dares to provoke Lord Gu, who is close to the Emperor, and disrespects Her Majesty the Empress. Hmm, I remember that she used to be so respectful and polite to Her Majesty the Empress. Now she even dares to keep Her Majesty waiting."

As soon as these words were spoken, Ganlu Palace fell silent.

Everyone looked at the Empress's expression.

However, the Empress remained calm, not at all provoked by Wang Wanyi's words.

During the palace coup, when Empress Yang wanted to kill her directly, the consorts had all remained silent like cicadas in cold weather. Only Xiangjun had thrown herself at her, disregarding her own life to plead for mercy on her behalf.

Where were their voices then?

Empress Xue Jiaojiao was not foolish; she was not so easily provoked.

Noble Consort Jian could not help but say, "Her Majesty the Empress, Sister Liang respects you the most. Her late arrival today must be for some reason."

"I know." The Empress smiled at Noble Consort Jian and nodded in satisfaction. "I and Noble Consort Liang are as close as sisters. I will not be provoked by a few words."

The phrase "as close as sisters" once again silenced the entire palace.

Her Majesty the Empress was truly good to Noble Consort Liang...

"Her Majesty the Empress!"

Suddenly, a young palace maid entered, prostrated herself on the ground, and kowtowed to Her Majesty the Empress.

Empress Xue was surprised. "Aren't you Xiyu, the palace maid serving Noble Consort Liang? What happened? Where is your mistress?"

Xiyu knelt on the ground, crying. "Her Majesty the Empress, our mistress fell from her sedan chair! She is covered in bruises and bleeding. But our mistress said that paying respects to Her Majesty the Empress is the most important thing. She must come to pay her respects to you. However, her clothes were torn, and she was afraid of offending you, so she returned to the palace to change. She sent me to ask for your forgiveness for her late arrival."

Upon hearing this, Empress Xue glanced at Wang Wanyi, who awkwardly covered her mouth with a handkerchief and silently picked up her teacup.

"You should have called for a physician first if she fell."

"Our mistress said she didn't break any bones, just some flesh wounds. Moreover, paying respects to Her Majesty the Empress is more important than anything else. Please do not blame our mistress for being late."

"It's fine. We don't have anything important. Everyone can wait for her."

After about the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, Xiangjun finally arrived fashionably late.

Everyone immediately looked at Noble Consort Liang to see where she was injured.

At first glance, her lip was indeed cut, and when she lifted her hand, the exposed wrist was also bruised. It seemed she had indeed fallen badly.

chapters.title: He Just Likes Bad Women Like Me
chapters.content:
The Empress Dowager saw Xiangjun enter and immediately beckoned her over, examining her as she asked, "How did you fall like this? The sedan chair carriers are too careless!"

"It wasn't the servants' fault. I just didn't sit steady."

"You're always covering for those servants! Everyone in the palace knows how good you are to them!"

"I'm just following the Empress Dowager's example. Your Majesty is so benevolent, and I am your student, so naturally I take you as my role model in everything."

Wan Yi, standing nearby, twitched her mouth. Thinking of her two first-class palace maids whose bottoms had been beaten to a pulp, she felt that this Consort Lian was capable of lying through her teeth.

The Empress pointed at Xiangjun and scolded her, then sighed, "Your mouth is so clever, it can turn black into white. Alright, just be more careful in the future."

Xiangjun nodded, then used a handkerchief to touch her lip, hissing in pain.

"Does it hurt?"

Xiangjun nodded pitifully, complaining, "This subject will never be a bad person again. That Eunuch Tingxue is so treacherous. I merely punished him by making him hold a candle stand, and the next day I fell from the sedan chair. What bad luck!"

Hearing this, many people couldn't help but laugh quietly.

Only a small palace maid sitting at the end secretly wiped her eyes with a handkerchief.

Last night, the Emperor had summoned the white palace maid, so today she had the right to pay respects to the Empress.

The white palace maid, seeing that no one was paying attention to her, sobbed a couple of times and quickly wiped away her tears.

...

The Emperor had a sensitive information network. By the time morning court ended, he already knew about the incident.

Seeing that Gu Tingxue looked listless, the Emperor felt a bit guilty.

"Consort Lian went too far, making you hold a candle all night. Don't be angry with her."

"This subject wouldn't dare."

Looking at Gu Tingxue's expression, the Emperor knew he held a grudge.

Although Gu Tingxue usually maintained a cold and detached demeanor, the Emperor knew very well that this man held grudges fiercely.

In the court, anyone who offended him would, within a few days, have evidence of their corruption and misconduct delivered to the Emperor's desk.

The Emperor thought for a moment, cleared his throat, and awkwardly lowered his voice to ask, "Today, Consort Lian falling from the sedan chair... it has nothing to do with you, right?"

Gu Tingxue was also taken aback, never expecting the Emperor to make such a connection.

He immediately lowered his eyes and cupped his hands, saying, "This subject absolutely did not do such a thing. She is Your Majesty's favored concubine. This subject would never dare to overstep so."

The Emperor let out a slight sigh of relief.

He certainly didn't want his closest minister to be at odds with his favored concubine every day like fighting roosters.

"You've been working hard these days. Take a couple of days off. You don't need to come to court."

"Thank you for Your Majesty's grace."

...

After court, the Emperor went to the Chengxiang Palace to see Xiangjun.

She was indeed quite badly injured.

Originally, he wanted to scold her for daring to torment an important court official like this, but seeing her pitiful appearance with a bruised mouth, he didn't truly reprimand her. He only told her to avoid Gu Tingxue in the future.

Xiangjun simply closed the palace gates and stayed inside to recover from her injuries.

Anyway, she had already made enough of a scene these past few days. The goal had been achieved.

In this palace, just being a good person wouldn't work. That would only make people think you're easy to bully. It's only by combining kindness with sternness that you can truly control others.

Meng Mei had kept watch the night before and, after resting well, heard that her mistress had fallen. She hurried over to check on Xiangjun's injuries. Upon learning that Xiangjun had intentionally fallen to cover up the marks left by Gu Tingxue, she couldn't help but say, "That Lord Gu has gone too far. How could he treat you like this?"

"It's fine. It's better for him to let out his anger than to keep it bottled up inside. Besides, how can you tame a fierce wild beast without getting a few scratches?"

Meng Mei tentatively asked, "Mistress, have you and Lord Gu made up?"

"More or less. He probably has... decided to let it go."

Meng Mei couldn't help but advise, "Mistress, Eunuch Tingxue is still very important. Although Lord Xu is now an official in the court, he can't enter the palace after all. Eunuch Tingxue is our eyes and ears outside the palace. You should be nicer to him. Don't really let someone snatch him away."

Xiangjun thought for a moment and said, "I've figured some things out these past few days."

"Mistress, what have you figured out?"

"For someone like Tingxue, who is good-looking, powerful, and has so many palace maids liking him, do you think in the more than twenty years of his life, he has never encountered a gentle, warm, innocent, and lovely woman?"

Meng Mei thought about it. It seemed unlikely that he hadn't.

"According to the information from the little paths, there might have been some girls who genuinely liked our Lord Gu. Since there must have been good girls around him, why did he stay away from women all these years?"

Meng Mei looked confused. "Eunuch Tingxue doesn't seem like someone who stays away from women, given the way he looks at you, Mistress."

Xiangjun smiled.

The first time she met Gu Tingxue, she had pretended to be pitiful and helpless. Seeing the look of disdain on Gu Tingxue's face, Xiangjun knew that he didn't like "normal" women.

Xiangjun placed a golden snake-shaped hairpin in her hair.

She had specially ordered this from the Sizhen room. The snake's eyes were inlaid with rubies, making it look lifelike.

Xiangjun looked at the golden snake coiled in her hair and said proudly, "Because he just likes bad women like me."

...

Xiangjun had intended to rest for a few days, but the little paths reported that the white palace maid was lingering outside the door of Chengxiang Palace. She didn't enter, didn't knock, didn't ask to be announced, just paced back and forth at the door, unwilling to leave, not knowing what she wanted to do.

"Let her in."

The white palace maid was brought in by the little paths.

Upon seeing Xiangjun, the white palace maid's eyes reddened. Xiangjun glared at her, and only then did she hold back her tears. Then, carefully, she took out a sachet from her bosom.

"Having heard that Mistress had fallen, this is a sachet I embroidered myself. I wanted to present it to Mistress."

Another sachet?

Xiangjun's eye twitched. Why did this white palace maid like giving people sachets so much?

Seeing that Mistress wasn't responding, the white palace maid panicked a little.

"Mistress, can't palace maids give embroidered sachets to the mistresses of the palace?"

Xiangjun rarely didn't know what to say.

"Of course you can..."

Xiangjun glanced at Meng Mei, who immediately took the sachet and handed it to Xiangjun.

Looking at the embroidery, it was the same as the one the white palace maid had given to Gu Tingxue before. It seemed she had indeed embroidered it herself.

"I gave you silver before. Why bother embroidering a sachet yourself?"

"This is my heartfelt gift to Mistress. Only by embroidering it myself is it sincere. Besides... in the palace, silver is needed everywhere. I wish I could reward people every day. The silver Mistress gave me, I need to use it sparingly."

Xiangjun was once again left speechless by the white palace maid.

She didn't respond, but squeezed the sachet. There seemed to be something inside.

"What's inside?"

"This is a medicinal herb I found in the Imperial Garden. If you chew it and place it on the wound, it can resolve bruising and stop the pain."

At these words, Xiaoluzi and Xiyu beside them burst out laughing. The other eunuchs and palace maids also couldn't help but stifle their laughter.

Only Xiangjun and Meng Mei didn't laugh.

Xiangjun coldly glanced at the crowd in the palace. The eunuchs and palace maids, feeling the pressure from Consort Lian, immediately shut their mouths and didn't dare make another sound.

Xiangjun looked at the sachet, squeezing the medicinal herb inside, deep in thought.

To be honest, in her previous life, she didn't have much impression of the white palace maid.

People she didn't remember were either never favored by the Emperor at all or had died early. This time, if it weren't for Xiangjun going to the Emperor to complain and mentioning the white palace maid, the Emperor probably wouldn't have remembered her at all.

The white palace maid's brother, in Xiangjun's memory, also wasn't promoted by the Emperor later. The one who rose to power was Zhou Zidou.

Xiangjun looked at the white palace maid, whose face was red with embarrassment and shame from the palace people's laughter, and inexplicably felt a surge of anger.

She finally understood why she couldn't stand the white palace maid.

"In the Two Instruments Hall, when the palace people laughed at you, did you also put on this pitiful look?" Xiangjun asked sharply.

chapters.title: Xiangjun Felt She Had Met Her Match for the First Time
chapters.content:
The white palace maid was so scared she almost knelt down again. Xiangjun, suppressing her anger, glanced at Meng Mei, who quickly pulled the white palace maid back to sit properly.

"Answer Mistress's question. You can sit while answering," Meng Mei said gently.

"I..."

"Don't say 'I' all the time. Refer to yourself as 'this concubine'."

"This concubine... this concubine is just a country girl. I... this concubine knows I don't understand anything. It's deserving to be laughed at."

"In my opinion, you haven't copied the palace rules enough times," Xiangjun said coldly, glancing at her. Then she added, "Servants laughing at their masters in front of them is always wrong."

Xiangjun looked at the several palace servants who were bowing their heads, not daring to speak. She picked up her tea cup and said indifferently, "This is the first time. I won't make things difficult for you. Slap yourselves twice."

Several slapping sounds rang out as the palace servants who had laughed at the white palace maid each slapped themselves twice. Xiaoluzi hit herself the hardest, not daring to hold back any strength.

The white palace maid was so scared she didn't dare to breathe.

"You must remember, in this harem, you can pretend to be pitiful, but you must not truly be pitiful. If you let others bully you, everyone will pounce on you and tear you apart. Be careful, or you'll end up with no place to bury your body."

The white palace maid nodded vaguely, only half understanding.

Seeing that the white palace maid was trying hard to listen but clearly not understanding, Xiangjun took another deep breath and looked at Meng Mei. She threw the sachet to Meng Mei and, enduring her annoyance, said, "You explain it to her. I have a headache."

Meng Mei, receiving Xiangjun's instruction, immediately spoke gently to the white palace maid, "White palace maid, the mistresses in the palace have imperial physicians to treat them. If they are injured, the imperial physicians will naturally provide medicine. There's no need to find herbs yourself, let alone chew them. It's fine to say such things to our mistress, but if you say them to other mistresses, you might be reprimanded. In more severe cases, giving you a beating would not be excessive."

"Even for this, I would be beaten?"

"If you let the mistresses consume things of unknown origin, you could be charged with harboring malicious intent. What would you do then? Moreover, even if you put herbs in the sachet with good intentions, if our mistress were to suffer because of it, what would become of you?"

"I know herbs very well. These herbs won't cause any problems. Mistress can have the imperial physician verify them."

Meng Mei, still gentle, continued to explain, "Our mistress naturally believes you have no ill intentions. But what if someone wants to harm the mistress and secretly replaces the herbs in your sachet with something lethal, then blames it on you? How many lives do you have to compensate, palace maid?"

Only then did the white palace maid realize the gravity of the situation. No wonder her brother had said to be careful in the palace—one wrong move could cost her life.

Her eyes widened like a startled deer, her face pale as she said, "Consort Lian, it was my ignorance. Please don't be angry with me. I... I will take back this sachet."

The white palace maid reached out to take back her sachet, but Xiangjun waved her hand, saying, "No need. Just be more careful next time. The embroidery on this sachet is not bad. Keep it. I will have the imperial physician check the herbs inside. If there's no problem, I will keep it properly. You have good intentions. Thank you."

This "thank you" was the warmest words the white palace maid had heard since entering the palace. Her eyes reddened again.
